description:

Job Description

The purpose of this role is to increase revenue, maximize process efficiency & cost-effectiveness, and ensure excellent customer experience, through effective supervision of daily operations and personnel, contract compliance, resource optimization and capability development within an account.

͏

  + Ensure a green card for all accounts in terms of performance and quality

  + Participate and share account performance across operational, quality and fulfillment parameters with internal and external stakeholders

  + Forecast and track key account metrics

  + Provide information required and resolve any invoicing issues raised by the client
* Collect and analyze statistics (costs, customer service metrics etc.)

͏

* **Ensure outstanding performance against key metrics mentioned in the agreement**

  + Set direction for the team, track progress against targets through regular cadence calls and course correct as require
  + Drive the focus of the team on quality and adherence to contract compliance processes
  + Drive and implement structured cadence around quality, both process and transactional
  + Cadence with delivery lead to ensure margins are met and the account numbers are at par to what is committed
  + Weekly calls with WFM to ensure resource optimization, compliance to the manpower numbers agreed in the contract, future planning in case of ramp ups etc.

͏

* Resource Allocation & Retention

title: Construction Site Supervisor
description:
**Company Description**
KKB BUILDCON is a growing construction firm committed to delivering high-quality residential and commercial projects in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The company focuses on robust planning, efficient project execution, and adherence to safety and regulatory standards. KKB BUILDCON emphasizes collaboration across engineering, procurement, and site teams to ensure timely completion of work. The organization values transparency, professionalism, and strong relationships with clients, contractors, and vendors. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their work and contribute to continuous improvement in construction practices.
  
**Role Description**
The Construction Site Supervisor will oversee daily site operations to ensure that work is carried out safely, on schedule, and in accordance with quality standards and project specifications. This full-time, on-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area includes coordinating workers and subcontractors, assigning tasks, and monitoring progress throughout the day. The supervisor will conduct site inspections, verify materials and workmanship, and ensure compliance with construction safety protocols and local regulations. Responsibilities also include maintaining site documentation, reporting issues to project management, resolving on-site challenges, and communicating clearly with engineers, contractors, and clients. The role requires proactive problem-solving, adherence to project timelines, and maintaining a clean, organized work environment.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong supervisory skills and experience in site supervision for building or infrastructure projects.
* Effective communication skills for coordinating with workers, contractors, engineers, and clients.
* Hands-on experience with site inspection, quality checks, and adherence to project specifications.
* Solid understanding of construction safety standards and ability to enforce safety procedures on site.
* Knowledge of construction methods, materials, and basic project scheduling.
* Ability to read and interpret drawings and technical documents.
* Minimum of a diploma or degree in civil engineering or a related field; relevant certifications in site management or safety are an advantage.
* Previous experience as a site supervisor or similar role in the construction industry, preferably within urban projects.
* Proven ability to work on-site full time, manage multiple tasks, and make timely decisions under pressure.

title: Mining Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Dhaatri Mines & Resources Pvt. Ltd. is a growing mining organization focused on responsible resource extraction and sustainable operational practices. The company emphasizes safety, regulatory compliance, and efficiency across all its mining projects. Team members collaborate closely to optimize production, maintain environmental standards, and improve operational performance. Dhaatri Mines & Resources Pvt. Ltd. offers opportunities for professional growth, leadership, and involvement in strategic decision-making within the mining sector.

**Role Description**
The Mining Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Kolkata metropolitan area, responsible for overseeing a
**10 people team**
who maintains day-to-day mining operations and ensuring safe, efficient, and compliant extraction activities. The role involves developing and implementing mine plans, coordinating with engineering and geology teams, monitoring production targets, and optimizing resource utilization. The Mining Manager will manage budgets, supervise site personnel, enforce safety protocols, and ensure adherence to regulatory and environmental requirements. This position also includes preparing operational reports, supporting long-term planning, and collaborating with senior management on project timelines and performance goals.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Mine Planning and Mining Engineering to design, implement, and optimize mine operations.
* Candidates should possess solid knowledge of Mine Safety to establish and enforce safety standards, procedures, and training.
* Candidates should possess proficiency in Budgeting to manage operational costs, resource allocation, and financial planning for mining projects.
* Candidates should possess a sound understanding of Geology to assess ore bodies, support exploration activities, and guide extraction strategies.
* Relevant qualifications such as a bachelor’s degree in Mining Engineering, Geology, or a related field; advanced certifications in mine management or safety are an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in managing mining operations, leading on-site teams, and working with regulatory bodies and environmental agencies.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with effective communication and leadership skills.
* Familiarity with mining software, production reporting tools, and applicable local and national mining regulations.

title: Owner
description:
**Company Description**
The Sparks Foundation is dedicated to enabling and connecting young minds to build the future. Guided by its vision and mission, the organization focuses on inspiring students to learn, create, and contribute to a better society. It encourages innovative thinking so learners can solve problems independently and confidently. The Sparks Foundation also promotes integration and collaboration, helping students learn from one another and succeed together.
  
**Role Description**
The Owner at The Sparks Foundation will lead the overall strategic direction, operations, and growth of the organization. This full-time, on-site role in Kolkata involves overseeing educational programs, managing key partnerships, and ensuring alignment with the vision to inspire, innovate, and integrate. The Owner will supervise staff, allocate resources, and monitor project delivery to maintain high-quality student experiences. Daily responsibilities include decision-making on organizational priorities, engagement with stakeholders, and continuous improvement of processes and initiatives. The role also includes representing the organization in external events, building community relationships, and ensuring compliance with relevant policies and standards.
  
**Qualifications**

* Experience in organizational leadership, strategic planning, and operational management in an educational or nonprofit setting.
* Strong skills in program development, curriculum oversight, and student-centered initiatives focused on innovation and collaboration.
* Proficiency in stakeholder management, including partnerships with schools, community groups, funders, and volunteers.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to motivate diverse teams and young learners.
* Demonstrated ability in financial oversight, budgeting, and resource allocation to support sustainable growth.
* Background in education, social impact, youth development, or a related field; a bachelor’s or master’s degree is highly beneficial.

**Job Description**

We are seeking an experienced Civil & Interior Project professional to lead end-to-end planning, execution, and delivery of projects with high end finishes. The role spans civil finishes works, interior works (joinery, finishes, MEP coordination), cost & schedule control, vendor management, and quality & safety compliance. The ideal candidate has hands-on site leadership, strong stakeholder communication, and demonstrable delivery of multi-site/commercial projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

Project Planning & Coordination

* Prepare and manage project plans, timelines, and work breakdown structures (WBS); track milestones.
* Conduct feasibility, site readiness assessments, and method statements; plan sequencing of civil and interior activities.
* Coordinate MEP interfaces with civil finishes (HVAC, electrical and lighting, plumbing fixtures, fire safety systems etc).
* Drive design development and shop drawings review; ensure GFC (Good for Construction) drawing alignment.

**Civil Works Execution**

* Oversee structural alterations, flooring, waterproofing, masonry, plastering, Flooring works (Granite/tiles/vinyl/epoxy etc), cladding (Granite/Marble/Wooden etc), painting; ensure compliance with IS codes and NBC India.

**Interiors / Fit-Out Delivery**

* Supervise joinery, modular furniture, partitions (gypsum/glass), ceilings, wall treatments, veneers, laminates, stone, metal, and soft finishes.
* Ensure sample approvals, mock-ups, material submittals, and finish schedules; maintain snag lists and close-out.
* Coordinate with designers for detail resolution (profiles, skirtings, reveals, edge bands, hardware).

**Vendor & Stakeholder Management**

* Manage subcontractors, supplier performance, and site workforce allocation; resolve site conflicts.
* Liaise with client representatives, architects, and consultants; run weekly progress reviews.

**Compliance, Safety & Documentation**

* Enforce EHS and site safety standards (PPE, method statements, tool box talks, risk assessments).
* Ensure statutory approvals and municipality norms are adhered to.
* Maintain daily logs, measurement books, RFI/RFP trackers, as-built drawings, and handover documentation.

**Quality & Handover**

* Implement quality control plans and benchmarks; conduct mid-project and final inspections.
* Drive commissioning (if applicable for MEP), snag rectification, and defects liability follow-up.

**Qualifications**

* Education: B.E./B.Tech in Civil Engineering (preferred), or Diploma with strong experience.
* Experience: 10+ years in civil & interiors projects (commercial office, retail, hospitality, or high-end residential).

+ Outgoing Payments and Returns

* Prior SAP BRIM CI role is a must
* Should have worked on minimum 1 implementation from scratch as a lead consultant.

* Experience on integration with third-party applications
* Knowledge of integration with SAP RAR, BRIM CI/SOM/CM
* Hands on experience in SAP S4 HANA Platform
* Experience on tools like JIRA or equivalent tool to maintain stories.
* SAP Utilities certifications are a plus:

+ Certification in SAP FICA (IUT240 / AC240 / BR240)
+ Certifications in SAP BRIM Convergent Invoicing (AC245 / BR245)

**Technologies and Tools**

* SAP FI-CA / FI-CAX
* SAP BRIM CI
* SAP FIORI
* Jira
* Azure DevOps

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience, and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY Utilities practices globally with leading businesses across a range of geographies

**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading‑book market risk & counterparty credit risk, banking‑book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements. As part of the Quantitative Trading Book (QTB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk, treasury, and front‑to‑back-office functions. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk and valuation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision‑making for clients with capital‑markets activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high‑impact capital‑markets engagements across global banks, broker‑dealers, asset managers, and insurance institutions.
  
  
EY is seeking a highly skilled Generative AI Specialist with expertise in developing / validating AI models. The successful candidate will be instrumental in driving innovation and enhancing our AI capabilities across various domains.

* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products
* Lead components of large-scale client engagements and/or smaller client engagements while consistently delivering quality client services
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.

* MRM (SR 11-7 experience) / Model Audit / Model governance along with Gen AI / Traditional AI
* Deep understanding of various neural network architectures, including convolutional neural networks (CNNs), recurrent neural networks (RNNs), transformers, and generative adversarial networks (GANs), along with their applications in supervised, unsupervised, and reinforcement learning.
* Proficiency in the development / validation of state-of-the-art generative AI models, including RAG structures, as well as experience with natural language processing (NLP) and large language models (LLMs), with skills in data preprocessing, model training, hyperparameter tuning, and evaluation metrics specific to generative tasks for creative content generation and data synthesis.

* Conduct comprehensive testing and evaluation of AI models on tasks such as text summarization, content generation, and other NLP applications.
* Experience in performance testing of AI models, including evaluation for hallucinations, toxicity, bias, robustness, adversarial attacks, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.
* Knowledge of responsible AI practices, ensuring fairness, transparency, and accountability in AI model development and deployment.
* Demonstrate ability to learn and apply new concepts, specifically in the area of financial risk management.
* Excellent communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Proficiency in Python and ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PySpark and PyTorch. Knowledge in AutoML tools which are used for automating the machine learning pipeline and Auto Kubernetes for managing containerized applications.
* Experience with cloud-based platforms for building, training, and deploying machine learning models, such as AWS SageMaker, Azure ML, or Google Cloud AI.
* Experience is writing validation reports as per MRM practices.

**What We Look For**

title: Start-Up Accelerator Lead
description:
* **Designation:**
  Start-up Accelerator Lead
* **Organization:**
  SwitchON Foundation
* **Location:**
  Kolkata (Candidates from Kolkata or willing to relocate)
* **Work Experience:**
  8 - 12 years of relevant experience
* **Compensation:**
  14-18 Lpa (Annual CTC will be decided based on experience, skills, and role fit)
* **Language Proficiency:**
  English; Hindi or regional languages preferred

**About SwitchON**

SwitchON Foundation
(est 2008) is a mission-driven organization working to strengthen
**sustainable agriculture, rural livelihoods, and climate resilience**
. We partner with Farmer Producer Companies (FPCs), Climate startups, investors, and institutions to build scalable solutions that create both economic and social impact.

Our growing enterprise platform combines
**acceleration, advisory, market access, capacity building, and investment facilitation**
to help FPCs and agri-enterprises and other climates become sustainable, growth-oriented businesses. Through strategic partnerships and ecosystem support, we enable enterprises to scale their impact and reach.

The SwitchON Foundation is part of the ON Universe, which operates an accelerator, impact fund and advisory that is dedicated to supporting proximate climate startups / social entrepreneurs and FPCs. Through the Greenovation and ONganic Accelerator—which runs challenges, bootcamps, and cohort-based programs—and the
EarthON Fund,
which leverages blended capital approaches, we address complex climate challenges across the Global South.

**Position Summary**

The Startup Accelerator Lead manages the day-to-day execution of our climate innovation accelerator programs, supporting both climate tech startups and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs). This role focuses on sourcing, evaluating, and supporting entrepreneurs and agri-collectives through structured acceleration initiatives. You'll work with founders, FPO leaders, mentors, investors, and ecosystem partners to help them achieve business readiness, investment readiness, and scale their climate and agricultural solutions.

This is an operational yet strategic role requiring strong execution capabilities, deep understanding of both startup and agricultural ecosystems, and the ability to bridge commercial innovation with ground-level rural impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Startup & FPO Sourcing & Pipeline Development**

* Build and maintain high-quality pipelines of climate startups, tech-enabled social enterprises, and Farmer Producer Organizations
* Design and execute recruitment campaigns across India
* Lead application review and evaluation processes aligned with accelerator criteria
* Manage cohort formation and maintain balance between startup, FPO, and sector diversity

**Startup & FPO Support & Acceleration**

* Provide mentorship, guidance, and strategic support to portfolio startups and FPOs
* Identify and address critical gaps in capabilities, business models, market fit, and operational efficiency
* Facilitate meaningful connections between startups/FPOs and mentors, investors, and strategic partners
* Track progress against KPIs and provide ongoing feedback tailored to each entity's stage and context

**Program Management & Execution**

* Design and deliver cohort-based acceleration programs (bootcamps, workshops, pitch events, farmer field schools)
* Oversee program curricula, logistics, and participant experience for diverse audiences
* Manage batches from application through demo day/showcase and post-acceleration support
* Build systems for monitoring progress, outcomes, and learning metrics

**Mentor & Investor Network Management**

* Curate and engage networks of mentors, technical experts, domain specialists, and agri-experts
* Facilitate introductions between startups/FPOs and ecosystem stakeholders
* Build relationships with angel investors, early-stage VCs, and impact funders
* Organize networking events, workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions

**Ecosystem & Partnership Development**

* Build relationships with corporate partners, universities, government agencies, and NGOs
* Develop partnerships for co-acceleration, pilot programs, market access, and distribution channels
* Collaborate with complementary accelerators, agricultural organizations, and ecosystem enablers
* Represent the accelerator at industry events and ecosystem convenings

**Program Quality & Reporting**

* Ensure high-quality execution across all accelerator initiatives
* Build monitoring, evaluation, and learning systems for continuous program improvement
* Maintain accurate reporting on cohort composition, startup/FPO metrics, and outcomes
* Generate insights and recommendations for program optimization

**Fundraising & Ecosystem Support**

* Support efforts to secure grants, corporate sponsorships, and philanthropic funding
* Develop compelling program documentation and impact narratives
* Engage with donors and ecosystem funders to communicate value and results

**Required Qualifications**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Management, Entrepreneurship, Business, Agriculture, Engineering, Development Studies, Environmental Science, or related field
* Master's degree preferred

**Experience**

* 8-10 years of relevant experience in one or more of:
* NGO/non-profit sector (required)
* Accelerators, incubators, or startup ecosystems
* Agricultural development, farmer collectives, or rural enterprise programs
* Program management in innovation, entrepreneurship, or social impact spaces
* Venture development or advisory roles
* Demonstrated experience working with farmer organizations, agricultural collectives, or rural communities
* Strong understanding of climate tech, sustainability, agri-innovation, or rural livelihoods sectors
* Proven track record of supporting entrepreneurs/social enterprises and building pipelines

**Preferred Skills & Competencies**

**Core Competencies**

* **Dual Ecosystem Knowledge:**
  Understanding of both startup ecosystems AND agricultural/rural development ecosystems
* **Leadership & Stakeholder Management:**
  Ability to manage diverse stakeholders—founders, farmers, investors, NGO partners, government officials
* **Program Management:**
  Experience designing and executing programs with measurable outcomes for different audiences
* **Communication:**
  Excellent ability to communicate with founders, FPO leaders, mentors, investors, and rural communities
* **Strategic Thinking:**
  Balancing operational execution with ecosystem development and long-term impact

**Technical & Domain Skills**

* Understanding of climate innovation, sustainability, renewable energy, or green livelihoods
* Familiarity with agri-tech, agricultural innovation, sustainable farming practices, or rural development
* Experience with startup evaluation frameworks and investment readiness criteria
* Knowledge of farmer collectives, FPC models, cooperative structures, and agricultural supply chains
* Understanding of blended finance or impact investing models (preferred)

**Operational Skills**

* Strong organizational and project management capabilities
* Ability to build systems and processes that work across different contexts (urban startups and rural FPOs)
* Comfortable with data tracking, analytics, and performance reporting
* Proficiency with startup ecosystem tools and digital platforms

**Personal Attributes**

* Entrepreneurial mindset with strong execution focus
* Passion for climate innovation and rural/agricultural impact
* Ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments
* Strong work ethic and comfort with ambiguity and multitasking
* High emotional intelligence and coaching ability
* Genuine interest in bridging the gap between technology innovation and ground-level agricultural transformation
* Comfort working across different contexts—urban tech spaces and rural communities

**Reporting & Collaboration**

**Reporting To:**
Leadership

**Key Collaborations:**

* Founder community and portfolio startups
* FPO leaders and farmer communities
* Mentor and investor networks
* Ecosystem partners (corporates, governments, universities, NGOs)
* Internal teams (Operations, Impact & Learning, Fundraising)

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate is:

* **NGO-rooted:**
  Brings deep experience and understanding of the non-profit sector and community-based approaches
* **Dual-focused:**
  Equally comfortable working with tech-savvy startup founders and with farmer leaders in rural areas
* **Execution-oriented:**
  Drives tangible results and builds systems that work in diverse contexts
* **Impact-driven:**
  Passionate about both climate solutions and agricultural transformation reaching the last mile
* **Relationship builder:**
  Strong ability to build trust and meaningful connections across different communities
* **Systems thinker:**
  Balances tactical program delivery with strategic ecosystem development
* **Adaptable:**
  Comfortable in evolving, resource-constrained environments with changing priorities
* **Field-experienced:**
  Ideally has spent time on the ground understanding farming communities and rural challenges
* **Data-conscious:**
  Uses metrics and learning to continuously improve programs while valuing qualitative impact stories

To learn more about our work, please visit:
www.switchon.org.in

**Travel for:**
Ecosystem events, Startup engagements ,Partner meetings, Investor interactions, National and international ecosystem convenings.

title: Lead Mechanical Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Sisir Radar Private Limited is building India’s first drone-borne Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR), delivering the world’s highest-resolution L-band SAR imaging capability. The company focuses on all-weather, day-and-night radar imaging that functions reliably through clouds, smoke, fog, and darkness, making critical data accessible and affordable. Its technology uncovers fine, previously invisible details for commercial, tactical, strategic, and civilian applications.

**Role Description**
The Lead Mechanical Engineer will oversee the mechanical design and development of drone-borne SAR systems and related hardware in an on-site role based in Kolkata. This full-time position involves leading the design of mechanical components and assemblies, creating and reviewing CAD models and drawings, and ensuring mechanical integrity, reliability, and manufacturability. The role includes coordinating with cross-functional teams (electronics, RF, software, and flight operations), managing project timelines and deliverables, and supporting prototyping, testing, and validation activities. The Lead Mechanical Engineer will also drive continuous improvement in mechanical design processes, mentor junior engineers, and contribute to research and development for next-generation radar platforms.

**Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in Mechanical Engineering with experience in machine design and structural analysis.
* Proficiency in Computer-Aided Design (CAD) tools for 3D modeling, detailing, and tolerance analysis.
* Experience in Project Management, including planning, scheduling, resource coordination, and risk management.
* Background in Research and Development (R&D), ideally in aerospace, robotics, or high-precision electromechanical systems.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Experience with lightweight structures, thermal management, and vibration/structural testing for airborne systems is an advantage.
* Familiarity with manufacturing processes, materials selection, and design for manufacturability and assembly (DFM/DFA).
* Ability to lead and mentor engineering teams, collaborate across disciplines, and communicate clearly in technical and non-technical contexts.

EY is seeking a Senior Manager – Frontier AI Security Lead / Layered Defence Lead to shape, scale, and lead the firm’s capabilities for securing frontier AI systems, generative AI platforms, LLM-powered applications, and agentic or multi-agent architectures. The role will focus on enabling trusted enterprise adoption of advanced AI by designing layered defence strategies that address risks across governance, data, model, agent, application, identity, runtime, and infrastructure layers.
  
  
This leader will define AI security strategy, reference architectures, control patterns, and delivery methodologies that help clients manage emerging risks such as prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, model and RAG poisoning, excessive agency, autonomous tool misuse, system prompt exposure, AI supply chain compromise, and unsafe model or agent behaviour.
  
  
The successful candidate will serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders and internal leadership, translating frontier AI risk into actionable security programmes, scalable managed capabilities, and market-relevant offerings. The role will also contribute to go-to-market strategy, sales pursuits, solution shaping, and the growth of EY’s AI Security practice.
  
  
The ideal candidate will combine deep cybersecurity, AI, cloud, architecture, and consulting experience with the ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, influence senior stakeholders, and build differentiated capabilities for securing AI at enterprise scale.
  
  
**Layered Defence Scope:**
The role will establish and mature layered defence patterns across the following AI security domains: governance and policy; data, knowledge, and retrieval pipelines; model access and prompt controls; agent planning, memory, tool use, and orchestration; application, API, and integration security; identity, access, secrets, and permissioning; runtime monitoring, telemetry, detection, and response; cloud, platform, infrastructure, and AI supply chain security.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Strategy and Practice Leadership**

* Define and drive EY’s Frontier AI Security and Layered Defence strategy across client and enterprise environments.
* Build and scale AI security offerings, delivery methods, reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, and control frameworks.
* Lead go-to-market development, sales pursuits, RFP responses, proposals, solution shaping, and commercial growth for AI security engagements.
* Establish a strong AI Security capability and community of practice, including talent development, enablement, knowledge sharing, and innovation priorities.

**Frontier AI Security Architecture**

* Architect secure AI systems across LLM applications, RAG pipelines, AI agents, multi-agent systems, model integrations, APIs, and enterprise platforms.
* Define defence-in-depth patterns across data, model, prompt, agent, application, identity, runtime, and infrastructure layers.
* Embed security into AI engineering lifecycles, including design reviews, threat modelling, secure build standards, MLOps, GenAIOps, DevSecOps, testing, deployment, and continuous monitoring.
* Advise clients on secure adoption of frontier AI capabilities, including high-risk use cases, autonomous workflows, and AI-enabled decision support.

**AI Risk, Red Teaming, and Control Design**

* Lead AI threat modelling and risk assessments for frontier AI use cases, including LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG systems, model providers, and third-party AI components.
* Establish AI red teaming and adversarial testing approaches covering prompt injection, jailbreaks, data exfiltration, model manipulation, tool abuse, excessive agency, and unsafe agent behaviour.
* Define and implement guardrails, policy enforcement, input and output validation, content safety controls, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, permission boundaries, and runtime response mechanisms.

* Strong understanding of frontier AI systems, LLMs, multimodal models, RAG, vector databases, agentic AI, multi-agent orchestration, model context protocols, and AI-enabled automation workflows.

title: Senior Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
Sandeep Mech. Engineers Ltd. (SMEL) manufactures engineering products for heavy machinery used across steel plants, mining, cement plants, power plants, and ports. The company’s core capabilities include precision machining, fabrication, and casting of specialized steel components for industrial applications. SMEL is known for producing conveyor pulleys, shafts, rope and winch drums, wheel assemblies, roller assemblies, bearing housings, gears, and crane equipment. The organization operates its own 2-ton casting unit equipped with induction furnace technology, supporting high-quality, in-house production and faster delivery. SMEL offers opportunities to work on complex, large-scale engineering projects in a dynamic industrial environment.

**Role Description**
The Senior Engineer role is a full-time, on-site position based in the Kolkata metropolitan area. The Senior Engineer will oversee the design, development, and manufacturing processes for mechanical components such as conveyor systems, shafts, drums, and other heavy machinery parts. Day-to-day responsibilities include reviewing technical drawings, coordinating with design and production teams, monitoring machining, fabrication, and casting operations, and ensuring adherence to quality standards and safety protocols. The role involves troubleshooting production issues, optimizing processes for efficiency and reliability, and guiding junior engineers and technicians with technical mentorship. The Senior Engineer will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, suppliers, and clients to ensure timely delivery of projects and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

**Qualifications**

* Strong mechanical engineering foundation, including experience with heavy machinery components, material properties, and manufacturing processes (machining, fabrication, and casting).
* Proficiency in engineering design and analysis tools (e.g., CAD software, basic FEA or other design validation methods) and the ability to interpret complex technical drawings and specifications.
* Experience in production planning, process optimization, and quality control within an industrial or plant environment, preferably related to steel, mining, cement, power, or ports.
* Demonstrated ability to lead technical teams, provide mentorship, coordinate with shop-floor staff, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and organizational skills, with attention to detail and a commitment to safety and regulatory compliance.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation, reporting, and client interaction.
* Bachelor’s degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or a closely related discipline.
* Relevant industry experience in a similar senior engineering or supervisory role; experience working with induction furnace casting units is an advantage.
* Willingness to work on-site at industrial facilities in the Kolkata metropolitan area and adapt to a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

WEG stands out in innovation by constantly developing solutions to meet the major trends in energy efficiency, renewable energy and electric mobility. With manufacturing units in 17 countries and present in more than 135 countries, the company has more than 45,000 employees worldwide.

Our business areas are divided as follows.
  
  
**Industrial Electro-Electronic Equipment**
This area includes electric motors, drives and industrial automation equipment and services, and maintenance services. Electric motors and other related equipment find applications in practically all industrial segments, in equipment such as compressors, pumps and fans, for example.
  
  
**Energy Generation, Transmission and Distribution (GTD)**
Products and services included in this area are electric generators for hydraulic and thermal power plants (biomass), hydro turbines (small hydroelectric plants or PCH, and hydroelectric generators or CGH)), wind turbines, transformers, substations, control panels and system integration services.

In this area, which includes liquid paints, powder paints, and electro-insulating varnishes, we have a very clear focus on industrial applications in Brazil and are expanding to Latin America and other regions.

title: Team Lead – Software Engineering
description:
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Team Lead to build and lead a team of software engineers developing a strategically important cloud-based platform that enables customers to check and improve the accuracy of their X-Rite color measurement devices.
  
  
This is a player-coach role, combining hands-on software development with technical leadership and people management. The role focuses on enabling team effectiveness, technical excellence, cloud-native architecture, and continuous improvement in a global engineering environment.
  
  
The team owns a modern web application built with TypeScript, React, Redux, HTML, CSS, AWS, Lambda, Node.js, and serverless technologies, as well as a companion Qt/C++ desktop application responsible for collecting and managing data that is integrated into the cloud platform.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of software engineers
* Hire, onboard, motivate, and coach team members, fostering engagement, growth, and a strong team culture
* Contribute hands-on to software development, including design, implementation, code reviews, and technical problem solving — leveraging AI throughout the software development lifecycle
* Provide technical leadership and guide architectural decisions for both the cloud platform and associated desktop applications in collaboration with global engineering teams (US, Switzerland, India, Germany, Netherlands, North Macedonia)
* Own and evolve scalable, secure, and maintainable cloud-native architectures on AWS
* Drive the evolution of frontend and backend systems, ensuring high performance, reliability, usability, and security
* Collaborate closely with product management, UX, QA, data engineering, and application support teams to deliver customer value
* Facilitate Agile ways of working (Scrum/Kanban), supporting effective planning, execution, prioritization, and delivery
* Establish and continuously improve software engineering practices, including testing, CI/CD, cloud operations, observability, security, and effective usage of AI
* Ensure seamless integration between cloud services and desktop applications that contribute data to the platform
* Work closely with global stakeholders across India, Europe, and the US to align technical direction with product strategy
* Drive a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, accountability, and engineering excellence

**Required Qualifications & Professional Knowledge**

* 8+ years of relevant experience in software engineering
* 3+ years of experience leading software engineering teams
* Strong hands-on experience building and maintaining modern web applications
* Several years of experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML, and CSS
* Strong backend development experience with Node.js and TypeScript
* Experience designing and operating cloud-native solutions on AWS or Azure
* Solid understanding of serverless architectures and services such as AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and related cloud technologies
* Experience designing scalable distributed systems and defining application architectures
* Ability to analyze customer and business requirements and translate them into robust technical solutions
* Experience establishing engineering best practices including testing strategies, CI/CD, code quality, monitoring, and security
* Solid understanding of modern web application architecture and software design principles
* Experience collaborating with UX, Product Management, QA, and other engineering disciplines
* Ability to collaborate effectively with global, cross-functional teams
* Solid understanding of the end-to-end software development lifecycle
* Experience working in Agile environments (Scrum and/or Kanban)
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English
* Willingness to travel (10%)

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading teams developing cloud-native SaaS or enterprise software platforms
* Experience with AWS services beyond Lambda and API Gateway, such as RDS, DynamoDB, S3, CloudWatch
* Experience with DevOps, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud automation
* Experience working with data-intensive applications, analytics platforms, or data pipelines
* Experience working in geographically distributed teams

**Nice to Have**

* Knowledge of desktop software development using C++ and Qt
* Experience integrating desktop, edge, or device-connected applications with cloud services
* Knowledge of color management, measurement systems, or hardware-connected software solutions

**Education & Experience**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
* :5+ years of experience delivering and evolving commercial software products throughout their lifecycle
* Experience balancing technical leadership, people leadership, and hands-on software development responsibilities

**Personal Attributes**

* Strong ownership mindset and ability to balance hands-on work with leadership responsibilities
* Passion for building high-performing engineering teams and developing people
* Collaborative and pragmatic approach in a cross-functional, global environment
* High learning agility and enthusiasm for modern software engineering practices, cloud technologies, and AI-assisted development
* Ability to make sound technical and organizational decisions in a fast-paced environment
* Effective communicator capable of aligning stakeholders across multiple functions and regions

Ability to operate effectively in a distributed team with partial timezone overlap (India ↔ US/EU)
  
  
We recognize that people come with a wealth of experience and talent. We believe in the value of unique perspectives, and we welcome candidates from diverse backgrounds who may not meet every criterion to apply and bring their distinctive experiences to our team.

title: Associate Director- Protection & Control
description:
At Jacobs, we're challenging today to reinvent tomorrow by solving the world's most critical problems for thriving cities, resilient environments, mission-critical outcomes, operational advancement, scientific discovery and cutting-edge manufacturing, turning abstract ideas into realities that transform the world for good.
  
  
Your impact
  
  
Jacobs is a global provider of technical, professional, and scientific services including engineering, architecture, construction, operations, and project management. Our portfolio spans industrial, commercial, and government clients across multiple markets and geographies. We have a PAN-India presence, with world-class engineering delivery centres in Mumbai, Delhi, Hyderabad, Bangalore, Pune, Chennai and Kolkata.
  
  
Challenging Today…Reinventing Tomorrow.
  
  
Jacobs is seeking a
**Associate Director- Protection & Control**
to support a range of high-profile projects across our Power & Energy portfolio. In this role, you will serve as a global Subject Matter Expert – Protection & Control, IEC 61850 & Digital Substations providing advanced technical leadership for protection and control engineering across substations, transmission and distribution systems, renewable interconnections, industrial power networks and digital grid infrastructure.
  
  
The SME will act as a technical authority for conventional, hybrid and fully digital substations, supporting projects across global markets including UK, Australia, Middle East, Europe, North America and Asia-Pacific. The role requires deep domain expertise in protection schemes, relay settings, substation automation, IEC 61850 integration, SCADA interfaces, cybersecurity, commissioning support and future-ready digital substation technologies.
  
  
**The Primary Responsibilities Would Be**
**Protection & Control Engineering**

* Provide specialist technical leadership for protection and control design of medium voltage, high voltage and extra high voltage substations.
* Lead, review and technically assure protection schemes for

+ Line protection
+ Transformer protection
+ Busbar protection
+ Breaker failure protection
+ Feeder protection
+ Capacitor bank and reactor protection
+ SVC / STATCOM protection
+ Renewable and BESS interconnection protection
+ Industrial power network protection
+ Grid connection and interconnection protection

* Lead and review key engineering deliverables including

+ Protection Single Line Diagrams / Key Line Diagrams
+ Protection and control schematics
+ Control logic diagrams
+ Trip and alarm matrix
+ AC/DC auxiliary schematics
+ Panel GA and BOQ
+ Wiring diagrams
+ Interface drawings
+ Interconnection schedules
+ Cable schedules
+ Relay assembled forms
+ Test and commissioning documentation

* Provide expert review of relay setting calculations and protection coordination studies.
* Review and approve relay settings, protection philosophies, technical reports and protection coordination documents.
* Provide technical direction for distance protection, differential protection, overcurrent protection, earth fault protection, REF, synchro-check, auto-reclose, breaker failure and busbar protection applications.
* Support fault level studies, protection grading, grid code compliance and system performance validation.
* Provide technical support during FAT, SAT, commissioning, energization and post-energization troubleshooting.
* Review vendor drawings, relay configuration files, test procedures, test reports and as-built documentation.

**IEC 61850 Integration and Digital Substations**

* Lead advanced engineering for IEC 61850-based digital substations, including concept design, detailed design, configuration strategy, integration, testing and commissioning support.
* Define and review complete digital substation architecture including

+ Station bus
+ Process bus
+ Protection IEDs
+ Merging units
+ SCADA gateways
+ HMI systems
+ Engineering workstations
+ Network switches
+ Time synchronization systems

* Provide expert guidance on IEC 61850 applications including

+ GOOSE messaging
+ MMS communication
+ Sampled Values
+ Logical nodes and data modelling
+ Dataset configuration
+ Report control blocks
+ GOOSE control blocks
+ Sampled Value control blocks
+ Multi-vendor interoperability

* Lead preparation and review of IEC 61850 deliverables including

+ IEC 61850 architecture drawings
+ Communication architecture
+ IED capability assessment
+ Signal lists and data point schedules
+ GOOSE mapping schedules
+ MMS mapping schedules
+ Sampled Value design documents
+ Logical node mapping
+ ICD, CID, IID, SCD and SSD file review records
+ FAT/SAT procedures for IEC 61850 systems

* Provide expert review and validation of IEC 61850 configuration files and ensure consistency between drawings, relay configuration, automation configuration and SCADA mapping.
* Lead or support multi-vendor integration involving Siemens, Hitachi Energy / ABB, GE Vernova, Schneider Electric, SEL, NR Electric and other global OEMs.
* Support digital substation testing using tools such as Omicron, Doble, Wireshark, IEDScout, StationScout, IET600, DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista and equivalent platforms.
* Guide project teams on migration from conventional hardwired systems to hybrid or fully digital substation architecture.
* Develop digital substation templates, standard architectures, reusable design libraries and configuration governance processes.

**Substation Automation, SCADA and Communication Networks**

* Provide technical leadership for substation automation systems, SCADA integration, RTU/Gateway interfaces, HMI systems and control centre communication.
* Review communication protocols and interfaces including IEC 61850, IEC 60870-5-101/104, IEC 60870-5-103, DNP3, Modbus, OPC UA, SNMP and synchrophasor interfaces where applicable.
* Lead design and review of digital substation communication networks including

+ Ethernet LAN architecture
+ Managed switch configuration philosophy
+ VLANs and IP addressing
+ Multicast management
+ PRP / HSR redundancy
+ Network segmentation
+ Remote engineering access
+ Network monitoring and diagnostics

* Provide guidance on time synchronization systems including IEEE 1588 PTP, SNTP, IRIG-B and GPS-based time sources.
* Review communication architecture for high availability, resilience and reliable operation of critical protection and control systems.

**Cybersecurity Considerations**

* Provide technical leadership on cybersecurity requirements for protection, control, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ensure cybersecurity is embedded across the engineering lifecycle from concept design through commissioning and handover.
* Review designs against relevant cybersecurity standards and requirements such as IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP where applicable, utility standards and client-specific cybersecurity requirements.
* Provide guidance on secure substation architecture including

+ Network segmentation
+ Defense-in-depth design
+ Secure remote access
+ Role-based access control
+ User authentication
+ Password and credential management
+ Firewall and gateway interface requirements
+ Secure engineering access
+ Logging and event monitoring
+ Asset inventory
+ Patch and firmware management considerations
+ Backup and recovery strategy
+ Configuration file control
+ IED, gateway, HMI and workstation hardening

* Define cybersecurity requirements for vendors and OEMs during specification, procurement, FAT, SAT and commissioning stages.
* Support cybersecurity risk reviews for IEC 61850 systems, SCADA links, remote access, vendor interfaces and third-party equipment.
* Promote secure-by-design principles for digital substations, renewable plants and future grid automation systems.

**Renewable Energy, Grid Connection And Future Capabilities**

* Provide SME support for solar, wind, battery energy storage, hybrid renewable plants, collector substations and grid interconnection facilities.
* Support protection design for inverter-based resources, weak grids, low fault current networks and changing grid behaviour.
* Provide technical guidance on grid code compliance for renewable interconnections across different countries and regions.
* Support future capability development in

+ Digital substations
+ Process bus implementation
+ Centralized protection systems
+ Virtual protection and control concepts
+ Wide Area Monitoring, Protection and Control
+ Synchrophasor-based applications
+ Digital twin for substations
+ Model-based engineering
+ Automated relay setting workflows
+ AI-assisted engineering checks
+ Cloud-based asset monitoring
+ Predictive maintenance
+ Cyber-secure remote commissioning
+ Standardized global digital substation delivery models

**Technical Assurance, Quality and Delivery**

* Act as the highest level of technical support for complex protection, control, automation and digital substation issues.
* Provide independent technical review, design assurance and quality validation for critical deliverables.
* Ensure engineering outputs comply with client specifications, utility standards, grid codes, IEC, IEEE, CIGRE recommendations, regional requirements and Jacobs quality procedures.
* Support project execution plans, design criteria, risk registers, assurance plans and quality review processes.
* Support resolution of client queries, technical deviations, design changes, non-conformances and site issues.
* Work with Design Project Engineers, Project Managers and global delivery teams to ensure projects are delivered on time, within budget and to expected quality standards.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of technical, commercial, schedule, risk, HSEC and quality aspects of projects.

**Client, Proposal and Capability Development**

* Lead technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs, contractors and global project teams.
* Support proposals, bids, tenders, technical estimates, capability statements and technical bid evaluations.
* Manage technical relationships and build appropriate level contacts with key clients.
* Strengthen client relationships through technical excellence, practical problem solving and high-quality project delivery.
* Mentor Lead Engineers, Senior Engineers, Graduate Engineers and design teams.
* Develop internal capability through training, technical sessions, lessons learned and knowledge sharing.
* Create and maintain technical standards, design guides, checklists, templates, automation workflows and best-practice documents.
* Drive innovation, digital delivery, standardization and future-ready engineering practices across the Protection & Control discipline.

Here's what you'll need
  
  

* BE / B Tech / ME / M Tech in Electrical Engineering.
* Minimum 18+ years of experience in Protection & Control engineering, substation automation, digital substations or associated power system engineering.
* Strong experience in MV, HV and EHV substation protection and control systems.
* Experience with substations up to 400kV / 765kV and above is desirable.
* Proven experience supporting international utility, renewable, industrial and grid connection projects.
* Expert knowledge of protection philosophies, relay applications, control systems, SCADA integration, substation automation and digital substation technologies.
* Strong experience in IEC 61850 design, configuration review, integration, testing and troubleshooting.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity requirements for protection, automation and digital substation systems.
* Ability to interpret international standards, utility requirements, client specifications and grid codes.
* Excellent technical report writing, communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to act as a global technical authority, mentor teams and support capability growth across the business.

**Mandatory Skill Sets**

* Expert-level knowledge of Protection & Control engineering for substations, T&D systems, renewable interconnections and industrial power networks.
* Strong knowledge of protection schemes, relay setting calculations, relay configuration, protection coordination and testing.
* Advanced knowledge of IEC 61850 including station bus, process bus, GOOSE, MMS, Sampled Values, logical nodes, datasets, control blocks and SCD file management.
* Strong understanding of digital substation architecture, IED integration, communication networks and multi-vendor interoperability.
* Strong awareness of cybersecurity standards and secure-by-design principles.
* Strong technical assurance, quality review and independent design checking capability.
* Ability to lead complex technical discussions with clients, utilities, OEMs and global project teams.
* Experience supporting FAT, SAT, commissioning and troubleshooting of protection, control and digital substation systems.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to articulate clear technical direction.

**Preferred Skill Sets**

* Experience with tools such as DIGSI 5, PCM600, EnerVista, Easergy Studio, AcSELerator, IET600, Omicron Test Universe, StationScout, IEDScout, Doble and Wireshark.
* Experience with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, MicroStation, ETAP, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, PSCAD or PSS/E.
* Experience in Australia, UK, Middle East, Europe, US or other international utility projects.
* Experience in solar, wind, BESS, hybrid renewable plants and grid interconnection projects.
* Experience with IEC 62351, IEC 62443, NERC CIP or utility cybersecurity frameworks.
* Knowledge of PRP, HSR, VLANs, multicast traffic management, PTP, SNTP, IRIG-B and network resilience requirements.
* Experience in model-based engineering, digital twin, automation workflows or data-centric engineering delivery.
* Basic understanding of Python or scripting for engineering process improvement is preferred.

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This role offers the opportunity to work within EY’s Financial Services Risk Management (FSRM) group, supporting leading global financial institutions in identifying, measuring, and managing risk including trading book market risk & counterparty credit risk, banking book credit risk, operational risk, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
As part of the Quantitative Banking Book (QBB) team within FSRM, you will contribute to strategic and functional transformation across risk management within the banking portfolio. You will apply quantitative skills to enhance risk estimation processes, support regulatory compliance, and develop analytics that drive better decision making for clients with lending activities. This is an opportunity for quant professionals looking to work on models, regulatory initiatives, and high impact capital markets engagements across banks, including large domestic and global financial institutions.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Demonstrate deep technical capabilities and industry knowledge of financial products, in particular lending products
* Understand market trends and demands in the financial services sector and issues faced by clients by staying abreast of current business and industry trends relevant to the client's business
* Monitor progress, manage risk, and effectively communicate with key stakeholders regarding status, issues and key priorities to achieve expected outcomes
* Play an active role in mentoring junior consultants within the organization
* Required to review, analyse and concur with tasks completed by junior staff
* Flexibility to work across projects involving model audits, validation and development activities

* Complete, end-to-end understanding of credit risk model development or validation for the banking book portfolio (PD/LGD/EAD)
* Should have hands on experience in data preparation, manipulation and consolidation
* Expertise in Stress Testing models and/or PD/LGD/EAD models
* Solid grounding in statistics and econometrics, especially logistic regression, linear regression, fractional response, decision tree
* Strong documentation skills. Required to be adept in quickly grasping key details and summarizing them in a presentation or document
* Strong knowledge in regulatory modelling (ECB/PRA/HKMA/Regulators) with model development/validation experience
* Strong technical skills, highly proficient in Advanced Python (Pandas, Numpy, ScikitLearn, Object Oriented Programming, Parallel Processing), SAS (SAS Certified Preferred), SQL, R, excel
* Should be able to take initiative and work independently with minimal supervision, if required
* Awareness of emerging AI/ML methodologies and their use in risk management, model validation, and quantitative workflow automation (experience in AI/ML will be preferred)
* Basic AI knowledge, excellent communication, analytical thinking, and problem solving skills

**Ideally, You Will Also Have**

* Good to have knowledge in Machine Learning models and its applications
* Advanced knowledge in AI is good to have.
* Previous project management experience

**What We Look For**

* Postgraduate (master’s in accounting, finance, economics, statistics or a related field) with at least 3 years of related work experience
* Regulatory knowledge in IFRS 9, IRB, CCAR, CECL, Stress Testing, DFAST
* Professional certifications (FRM, SCR, RAI, CFA, PRM are a plus)
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and support engagements with global financial institutions
* Willingness to travel based on client needs.

**What We Offer You**

Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

* Communication: EXCELLENT verbal and written communication skills with proven ability in client-facing roles, blueprinting, and user training.
* SAP S/4HANA Knowledge: Solid understanding of SAP S/4HANA differences compared to ECC (e.g., Universal Journal integration, Material Ledger enhancements, CO-PA architecture).
* Project Lifecycle: Hands-on participation in at least 2+ full-cycle implementations, roll-outs, or major support/enhancement projects from requirement gathering to Go-Live.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Core SAP CO Modules:

+ General Controlling, Cost Center Accounting (CO-OM-CCA), and Profit Center Accounting (EC-PCA).
+ Product Costing (CO-PC) covering Make-to-Stock (MTS) and Make-to-Order (MTO) scenarios.
+ Material Ledger (ML) and profitability analysis (CO-PA), including Report Painter, CO-PA Realignment, and Top-Down Distribution.

* Month-End Closing Excellence: Expert execution and troubleshooting of month-end closing tasks in CO, including Work in Process (WIP) calculation, Variance Analysis, and Order/Project Settlement.
* Specialized CO Scenarios:

+ Overhead management (Overhead keys, Overhead groups).
+ Advanced costing methods: Additive costing, Job costing, Batch costing, Mixed costing, Joint product, By-product, and Co-product costing.
+ Origin groups and Auxiliary Cost Component structures.

* Cross-Functional Integration: Seamless integration of SAP CO with FI, MM, SD, PP, and PM modules, alongside integration with BW or BI.
* Project Delivery & Methodology:

+ Lead Business Process Re-engineering (BPR), Solution Building, Blueprinting, and GAP Analysis.
+ Design and execute Unit Testing, Integration Testing, and prepare comprehensive user manuals and training documentation.
+ Manage and prioritize multiple assignments simultaneously to meet rigorous delivery schedules.

* Technical Coordination & Interfaces: Collaborate with technical teams for custom object development, and handle interface configurations including RFC connections and Background Job Tools.

title: ADN-Canada NFS-Senior
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY- Assurance – Senior Associate**
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
* Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
* Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
* Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
* Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
* Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
* Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
* Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
* Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
* Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
* Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
* Excellent communication skills.
* Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
* Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
* Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
* The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
* 0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
* Interest in business and commerciality.

**What We Look For**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
* Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
