title: Program Manager-PL
description:
**Job title:**
Program Manager
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Managing Director
  
  
**Location**
: Noida/Kolkata (Open for all India travel)
  
  
**About Axiom Consulting**
Since 2002, we have witnessed the transformation of the Indian economy, led by multi-generational
  
  
Indian business families who have successfully evolved their family-run businesses into mid-to-large
  
  
corporations. Participating in this economic transformation from the boardrooms of some of India's
  
  
most prominent business houses has given us deep confidence in the economic and growth potential of
  
  
our diverse country.
  
  
Over the last three decades, we have developed deep domain expertise across Manufacturing, Retail,
  
  
Distribution and Service industries, integrating and automating business processes on global ERP, CRM
  
  
and HR platforms. In addition, we have built our own distribution management, point-of-sale, vendor
  
  
and customer portal solutions to close process gaps around global platforms for our clients.
  
  
**Who We Are**
We are an ERP-led business transformation and implementation organization focused on helping clients
  
  
move from fragmented processes and systems to integrated, standardized and best-practice-driven
  
  
operations.
  
  
**Our approach to ERP implementation rests on two key tracks:**

* Industry Best Practices & ERP Transformation We evaluate a client's existing processes against relevant industry and functional best practices and enable these through leading ERP platforms such as SAP and Microsoft Dynamics. The objective is not simply to implement software, but to establish standardized processes, controls and operating models that reflect proven industry practice.
* Sustained Organizational Change ERP implementation also requires sustained organizational transformation and change management. We work with clients to embed new processes, behaviours and practices into the day-to-day habits of their workforce - ensuring the solution delivers lasting business value rather than becoming only a technology deployment.

**OUR CLIENT SEGMENT**
**The Role Will Support Clients Across Three Broad Segments**
▪ Multinational companies operating in India and other regions.
  
  
▪ Large Indian corporates with complex and diverse finance operations.
  
  
▪ Fast-growing, family-owned and professionally managed mid-sized businesses, generally in the
  
  
₹200–800 crore range.
  
  
**OUR FOCUS AREAS**
We maintain a strong focus on Compliance and Corporate Governance, supported by a Centre of
  
  
Excellence comprising experienced functional and domain professionals.
  
  
Our clients typically come from non-ERP or fragmented-system environments, where business
  
  
processes are managed through standalone applications or disconnected modular systems across
  
  
departments. This calls for an articulate leader who can effectively drive high-level conversations across
  
  
diverse steering committees and technical groups — managing governance, schedule and scope with an
  
  
80% onsite/onshore presence.
  
  
**Role, Scope & Responsibilities**
We are seeking a seasoned Senior Program Manager with 10+ years of experience to lead large-scale
  
  
enterprise transformation programs. The ideal candidate will bring a stable career history (a maximum
  
  
of 1–2 employers) and a proven track record of driving complex software, ERP and CRM
  
  
implementations.
  
  
As our projects and client relationships typically span 10–15 years, the most important hiring mandate is
  
  
stability: candidates should have at least 8–10 years of single, continuous tenure with a Top Tier
  
  
company.
  
  
▪ Drive Executive Conversations: Lead, influence and drive strategic conversations with C-suite
  
  
executives, business heads and partners to secure buy-in and align expectations.
  
  
▪ Lead Enterprise Transformations: Direct complex implementations across Software/ERP platforms
  
  
(Microsoft, SAP), including surround technologies and other custom solutions.
  
  
▪ Facilitate Governance & Alignment: Own the project schedule, scope and governance framework chairing steering committee meetings and cross-functional workshops.
  
  
▪ Manage RAID & Risks: Proactively identify, articulate and mitigate program risks, assumptions,
  
  
issues and dependencies (RAID) during stakeholder reviews.
  
  
▪ Onshore Leadership: Operate effectively in an onsite/onshore model (80% presence), driving daily
  
  
face-to-face collaboration with client teams.
  
  
**IDEAL CANDIDATE**
▪ Experience: 10+ years of core project and program management experience.
  
  
▪ Communication: Exceptional verbal and written skills, with the ability to drive complex
  
  
conversations between business users and technical teams.
  
  
▪ Professional Stability: A stable, progressive career track record — preferably 1–3 organisations, with
  
  
at least 80% of total tenure spent at a single organisation.
  
  
▪ Target Background: Proven delivery experience within tier-1 tech integrators and consulting firms,
  
  
such as IBM, Wipro, TCS, CTS, Infosys, HCL, Capgemini, Accenture, Deloitte, PwC, EY, etc.
  
  
▪ Methodologies: Expert knowledge of program governance, budgeting and structured deployment
  
  
frameworks.
  
  
**Out Of Scope — What This Role Is Not**
Candidates whose primary experience lies in the following areas will not be considered:
  
  
▪ Service delivery management or support-operations projects.
  
  
▪ Ticket management, SLA tracking, or ITSM frameworks.
  
  
▪ Pure resourcing / team management.
  
  
▪ Core infrastructure, networking, or technical migration projects (DWH / Cloud / Infra).
  
  
▪ Candidates not comfortable with the travel required for client engagements.
  
  
Skills: budgeting,program governance,program,structured deployment frameworks,projects

title: Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager
description:
**Overview**
**Working at Atlassian**
Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.
  
  
**Why should you apply to this role?**
The Principal Enterprise Delivery Manager is responsible for ushering Atlassian’s largest, most complex customers through their transition into the cloud. As the primary stakeholder, you will act as a reliable strategic advisor and technical consultant to senior customer decision-makers, while also leading the delivery and governance of large-scale Cloud migrations.
  
  
You bring both business acumen and technical fluency. You will work closely with customer stakeholders and cross-functional teams—including Sales, Solutions, Support, Product Management, Channel Partners, and Engineering—to help navigate architectural decisions, risk mitigation, performance guardrails, and adoption planning.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, and execution — whether you come from delivery management, DevOps, QA/testing, or engineering. It requires proven expertise in developing and influencing customer cloud strategies and enabling technical adoption of cloud features, including AI. You understand how data moves, systems integrate, and migrations succeed (or fail). You will identify potential challenges and implement effective solutions that guide toward positive outcomes and ultimately lead Atlassian’s most strategic customers to Cloud.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Migration Strategy:**
Lead end-to-end cloud transformation engagements by evaluating customer environments and aligning technical execution with business outcomes.
  
  

* Risk Management: Facilitate migration readiness assessments, interpret guardrail results, and recommend actionable remediations (i.e. SQL-based analysis, app remediations, automation deltas, workflow redesign).
* Technical Architecture: Understand and communicate the role of APIs, webhooks, and automation components in customer environments — explaining how they translate to Cloud and what requires refactor or replacement.
* Trusted Advisor: Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and other technical executives, guiding decision-making through data-backed insights.
* Delivery Excellence: Govern the migration lifecycle through disciplined execution, measurable outcomes, and coordination with support & engineering teams — from discovery to UAT completion and go-live.
* Drive Accountability: Drive team accountability through clearly defined milestones, transparent reporting, proactive risk management and optimal resourcing.
* Stakeholder Management: Lead all project communications, plan reviews, and steering committee to guide project direction. Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to advocate for the team and meet customer objectives.
* Escalation Management: Act as the escalation point for customers to drive urgency on critical blockers during migrations.
* Team Leadership: Mentor peers on technical literacy and lead internal enablement efforts, including training workshops and playbook development. Model a consultative, data-driven mindset expected of Atlassian’s delivery leaders.

**Industry Insight:**
Stay ahead of industry trends and integrate insights into customer interactions. Propose innovative solutions to business challenges.
  
  
**Compensation**
At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensation programs. We follow consistent hiring practices and account for each candidate's skills, knowledge, and experience when setting base pay within the range.
  
  
This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.
  
  
**Qualifications**
Qualifications
  
  

* Extensive experience working in or around software delivery — roles such as Delivery Manager, DevOps Engineer, QA/Test Lead, Systems Engineer, or Support Lead are a plus
* Proven track record leading data migration, systems integrations, or platform transformations.
* Knowledge of APIs, automations, and integration patterns, including how they translate between on-prem and cloud.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) — able to connect process, tooling, and delivery outcomes.
* Strong ability to influence customer decision-making through expertise in delivery knowledge and value discussions.
* Skilled in negotiating effectively with senior-level decision-makers and c-suite executives.
* Demonstrated leadership, teamwork, and mentorship skills that enhance team learning and engagement.
* Over 10 years of professional experience as a technical program/delivery manager responsible for complex technology projects for enterprise customers.
* Bachelor’s or advanced degree in engineering, computer science, or equivalent professional experience.

**Benefits & Perks**
Atlassian offers a wide range of perks and benefits designed to support you, your family and to help you engage with your local community. Our offerings include health and wellbeing resources, paid volunteer days, and so much more. To learn more, visit
**go.atlassian.com/perksandbenefits**
**.**
**About Atlassian**
At Atlassian, we're motivated by a common goal: to unleash the potential of every team. Our software products help teams all over the planet and our solutions are designed for all types of work. Team collaboration through our tools makes what may be impossible alone, possible together.
  
  
We believe that the unique contributions of all Atlassians create our success. To ensure that our products and culture continue to incorporate everyone's perspectives and experience, we never discriminate based on race, religion, national origin, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or marital, veteran, or disability status. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
  
  
To provide you the best experience, we can support with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our Recruitment team during your conversation with them.
  
  
To learn more about our culture and hiring process, visit
**go.atlassian.com/crh**
**.**
In line with local law, identity verification (which may include use of biometric data) is a condition of employment with Atlassian for employment fraud purposes.

* Ability to produce high‑quality process maps, data flows, and requirement documentation.
* Proficiency in managing multi‑vendor engagements and navigating complex project environments.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret data, identify gaps, and propose practical solutions.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills for client‑facing interactions.

title: TMF Lead
description:
**Job Description:**
JOB TITLE: TMF Lead
  
  
LOCATION:
  
  
**Job Overview**
The TMF Lead is responsible for day-to-day TMF leadership for assigned clinical studies. The role coordinates study TMF activities, provides status and risk information to stakeholders, and directs the work of supporting TMF Specialists and Associates. The TMF Lead creates and maintains the TMF Plan, leads or creates the TMF build, and coordinates periodic TMF quality control and remediation with oversight from TMF management.
  
  
**Job Duties And Responsibilities**

* Coordinates TMF activities across the lifecycle of assigned studies and serves as the routine TMF contact for the study team.
* Creates, maintains, and implements the study-specific TMF Plan and associated records with review and approval from the Project Manager and Sponsor.
* Leads the initial TMF build for assigned studies, including structure, expected document packages and ad hoc placeholder creation in accordance with approved standards.
* Maintains TMF expectations as study scope, milestones, countries, sites, vendors, or responsibilities change.
* Plans and coordinates periodic TMF QC in accordance with the TMF Plan and procedures, including assignment, completion tracking, documentation, and follow-up.
* Reviews periodic QC findings, coordinates remediation, verifies completion, identifies repeat issues, and escalates significant trends or unresolved actions.
* Monitors TMF completeness, quality, and timeliness and provides regular status reports to study and functional stakeholders.
* Coordinates document collection, review, indexing, filing, reconciliation, and issue resolution across internal and external contributors.
* Identifies and investigates missing, incomplete, inconsistent, late, or misfiled documents and assigns or escalates corrective actions.
* Provides task direction, priorities, and technical guidance to TMF Specialists and Associates supporting assigned studies.
* Participates in study meetings and communicates TMF requirements, status, risks, actions, and upcoming milestones.
* Interacts directly with sponsors to provide TMF status updates, discuss risks and actions, confirm expectations, and support study decisions within delegated authority.
* Supports audit and regulatory inspection readiness, document retrieval, response preparation, and remediation.
* Coordinates final TMF review, reconciliation, closeout, transfer, archival, and sponsor return activities.
* Provides TMF training and eTMF system support to TMF Specialists and Associates, study team members, sponsors, and other users and escalates system issues when required.
* Escalates material risks, recurring quality issues, resource concerns, and decisions outside delegated authority.
* Performs other related duties as assigned by departmental management.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
No routine direct supervisory responsibility. Provides study-level task direction and technical guidance to TMF Specialists and Associates assigned to the study.
  
  
**Job Requirements**
EDUCATION
  
  

* College or university degree. A healthcare, life science, information management, or related degree is a plus.
* An equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience may be considered.

**Experience**

* Typically minimum of six years of experience in TMF, records management, clinical operations, or a related regulated function.
* Experience coordinating TMF activities and working with cross-functional study teams.
* Experience creating or maintaining TMF Plans, supporting or leading TMF builds, and coordinating periodic TMF QC is preferred.

**Skills/Competencies**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English
* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate with global internal and external study teams
* Strong computer skills, including Microsoft Office and electronic Trial Master File systems
* Knowledge of the clinical trial lifecycle, essential documents, and applicable TMF requirements
* Knowledge of ICH Good Clinical Practice and applicable regulatory requirements
* Exceptional attention to detail and a consistent focus on document quality
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage competing priorities and timelines
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and changing environment
* Demonstrates honesty, trust, fairness, cooperation, self-control, and flexibility
* Strong working knowledge of TMF structure, essential documents, metadata, and records lifecycle activities
* Strong coordination, facilitation, problem-solving, and escalation skills
* Ability to interpret reports and QC findings and coordinate appropriate remediation
* Ability to work independently within approved plans, procedures, and delegated authority

**Capabilities**

* Able to work flexible hours to accommodate study team and sponsor requirements
* Able to travel based on study and business need
* Able to perform office-based or remote work as assigned
* Minor lifting of less than 30 pounds may be required

title: Lead Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
At Cision, we believe in empowering every individual to make an impact. Here, your voice is heard, your ideas are valued, and your unique perspective fuels our collective success. As part of our global team, you'll thrive in an environment that champions curiosity, collaboration, and innovation, all while making meaningful contributions to the brands we accelerate.
  
  
Join us in shaping the future of communication and building authentic connections that matter. Whether you're solving complex problems or driving bold innovations, your growth is our success, and together, we’ll create the conversations of tomorrow.
  
  
**Empower your impact at Cision. Be seen, be understood, be you.**
**Job summary:**
We are seeking a Lead Business Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team and play a critical role in shaping how data, insight, and AI are translated into commercial advantage across the Revenue Organization. This role will act as a senior individual contributor and thought partner to RevOps, Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Finance.The Lead Business Analyst will own the definition, delivery, and continuous improvement of commercial analytics, KPI frameworks, and executive-ready reporting. They will work closely with Data Engineering and Systems teams to ensure data accuracy, clarity, and usability — while maintaining a strong focus on business outcomes rather than reporting/predicting output alone.
  
  
Critically, this role sits at the intersection of data, AI, and people. The ideal candidate will be as comfortable enabling a frontline sales rep to understand and act on a dashboard as they are presenting strategic insight to a C-suite audience. They will also be a confident and curious adopter of large language model (LLM) tools — using AI to accelerate their own analytical workflow and helping the wider business do the same.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Analysis & Stakeholder Partnership

+ Act as the primary analytics partner to senior commercial stakeholders across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Revenue Operations.
+ Apply strong business analysis discipline — translating ambiguous business questions into well-scoped requirements, clear success criteria, and structured analytical briefs before any build begins.
+ Proactively surface insights, trends, risks, and opportunities that inform decision-making at leadership level.
+ Support strategic initiatives such as CRM consolidation, demand intelligence optimization, territory and book-of-business changes, and forecasting improvements.
+ Own end-to-end project management of analytics deliverables — from requirements gathering and prioritization through to delivery, adoption, and iteration — ensuring stakeholders are informed and timelines are met

* Communication, Enablement & Influence

+ Demonstrate exceptionally strong communication skills across all levels of the organisation — from crafting executive narratives for senior leadership forums to running hands-on enablement sessions for managers and frontline sales representatives.
+ Translate complex data, AI outputs, and analytical findings into plain-language stories that drive clarity, confidence, and action.
+ Design and deliver enablement programmes that help managers and reps understand, trust, and act on dashboards, KPIs, and AI-generated insights — building genuine data literacy across the Revenue Organisation rather than dependency on the BI team.
+ Champion clear, consistent communication of what metrics mean, how they are calculated, and why they matter — removing ambiguity at every level.
+ Influence without authority; build credibility with senior stakeholders through the quality of insight and the integrity of the underlying data.

* Analytics, Reporting & Insight

+ Own the design and delivery of executive-level dashboards and self-service reporting, primarily using Power BI.
+ Ensure consistent definitions and calculations for revenue KPIs, North Star metrics, and commercial performance indicators.
+ Conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose performance issues and recommend actionable next steps.
+ Write and optimise advanced SQL queries to extract, transform, and validate data across our Databricks data warehouse and connected source systems.
+ Leverage Databricks as the central analytical platform — working within notebooks, SQL warehouses, and the broader Lakehouse environment to build reliable, scalable analytical outputs.

* AI & LLM Integration

+ Be a power user and internal advocate of LLM-based tools, including Microsoft Copilot and Anthropic Claude (including Claude Code), using them to accelerate analysis, generate and review SQL, draft communications, and surface insight more efficiently.
+ Help define and create LLM agents for the Go To Market organisation – connecting context to frontline AI tools such as MS Copilot and Salesloft.
+ Proactively identify opportunities to embed LLM and AI capabilities into BI workflows, dashboards, and analytical processes — raising the ceiling of what the team can deliver.
+ Work with the Senior Manager of BI to evaluate and scale AI-assisted analytics approaches across the team, including the use of Databricks' native LLM and AI capabilities.
+ Help commercial stakeholders and frontline teams understand and appropriately trust AI-generated outputs — building confidence in AI tools through clear explanation, demonstration, and enablement.

* Data Modelling & Quality

+ Partner with Data Analytics Engineers to define analytical data models that support revenue, pipeline, customer lifecycle, and performance reporting.
+ Validate data accuracy and integrity across the analytics layer, proactively identifying and resolving issues before they impact decision-making.
+ Contribute to data governance standards, metric documentation, and reporting best practices.

- Technology & Tooling Context

+ The Lead Business Analyst will work within a modern BI and revenue intelligence stack, including:
+ Layer Tools
+ Data Warehouse & Analytics Databricks (central data warehouse with LLM capabilities)
+ BI & Visualisation Power BI
+ AI & LLM Tooling Microsoft Copilot, Anthropic Claude, Claude Code, Databrick Genie, Databricks hosted LLM models
+ Core Commercial Systems Salesforce (multiple instance), PlanHat, &
+ Revenue & Demand
+ Intelligence Clay
+ Sales Enablement &
+ Engagement Salesloft (including AI and conversational intelligence) & HighSpot
+ A strong understanding of how these systems connect — and how data flows end-to-end from source systems to executive dashboards and frontline tools — is essential.
+ Required Experience & Skills

+ 8+ years of experience in a Business Analysis, Analytics, or BI within a SaaS or technology-driven organisation.
+ Experience supporting RevOps, Sales Operations, or Commercial Analytics teams.
+ Advanced SQL skills — comfortable writing complex queries, debugging data issues, and working directly within a cloud data warehouse environment; Databricks experience strongly preferred.
+ Strong business analysis capability — proven ability to scope, structure, and document analytical requirements with rigour before moving into delivery.
+ Proven project management skills — able to manage multiple concurrent workstreams, set and meet deadlines, and maintain clear stakeholder communication throughout.
+ Exceptionally strong communication skills — a natural and compelling communicator in written and verbal form, equally effective presenting strategy to a VP as running a training session for a team of account executives.
+ Demonstrated experience designing and delivering stakeholder enablement on data, dashboards, or analytics tooling — not just building outputs, but ensuring they are understood and adopted.
+ Proven experience delivering executive-ready dashboards and self-service reporting (Power BI preferred).
+ Strong commercial and revenue-focused business acumen.
+ Active and confident user of LLM tools such as Microsoft Copilot or Anthropic Claude in a professional analytical context.
+ Preferred Experience

+ Hands-on experience with Databricks — including SQL warehouses, notebooks, and the Lakehouse architecture.
+ Experience using Claude Code or similar AI coding assistants to accelerate SQL development, data validation, or analytical scripting.
+ Familiarity with CRM and GTM analytics — Salesforce, pipeline reporting, forecasting, MEDDPICC, territory models.
+ Hands-on Experience with Clay
+ Ideally experience with Python (e.g. connecting to APIs)
+ Exposure to building or scaling data literacy programmes within a commercial organisation.
+ What Success Looks Like

+ Leaders trust the dashboards and insights/recommendations produced and use them to run the business with confidence.
+ Managers and frontline reps understand and act on data, insights, and AI outputs — because this role has invested in enabling them, not just building for them.
+ KPIs and metrics are clearly defined, consistently applied, and widely adopted across the organisation.
+ LLM and AI tools are meaningfully embedded into BI workflows, improving speed, quality, and reach of analytical output.
+ The BI team is seen as a strategic partner — not just a reporting function.
+ Data quality issues are proactively identified and resolved before impacting decision-making.
+ Projects are delivered on time, with clear communication and minimal surprises for stakeholders.

The
**o9 Solutions Integration (INT3.0) & Data Lead**
is responsible for
**owning, governing, and continuously improving the technical integration landscape**
supporting the
**o9 Solutions IBP platform**
. The role provides
**hands-on Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) expertise**
from day one, translating integration requirements into reliable, supportable, and scalable data flows across o9 and upstream or downstream enterprise systems.
  
  
This position acts as the technical integration authority within the IBP CoE. It combines architecture, delivery, operations, troubleshooting, documentation, and stakeholder leadership. This person will work closely with functional leads, the Solution Architect, data teams, infrastructure and security teams, implementation partners, and business stakeholders to ensure that integrations are production-ready and sustainably transitioned into support.
  
  
**Role Purpose and Outcomes**

* Own the o9 INT3.0 integration workstream and provide practical, recent implementation expertise with minimal dependency on project-team knowledge transfer.
* Establish stable, traceable, and supportable inbound and outbound interfaces for IBP planning processes.
* Improve operational resilience through runbooks, batch monitoring, error-log knowledge, root-cause analysis, and repeatable recovery procedures.
* Enable faster and safer releases by applying technical design standards, quality controls, and disciplined deployment practices.
* Support targeted Python-based plug-ins, procedures, and automation under the guidance of functional and solution leads.

**What You'll Do**
**Key Responsibilities**
**o9 Integration 3.0 Technical Ownership**

* Act as the primary technical owner for o9 Integration 3.0 across design, build, testing, deployment, and production support.
* Design and maintain integration patterns for master, transactional, planning, and analytical data exchanged between o9 and enterprise systems.
* Assess integration requirements, define technical options, document decisions, and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture and security standards.
* Provide technical guidance to internal teams, vendors, and implementation partners, and review integration deliverables for quality and maintainability.

**Integration Engineering and Data Flows**

* Develop, configure, enhance, and troubleshoot data ingestion and extraction pipelines, transformations, orchestration, schedules, and dependencies.
* Work with ERP, data-platform, middleware, cloud, and data-provider teams to define interface contracts, mappings, validation rules, cadence, and ownership.
* Ensure integrations correctly handle full and delta loads, sequencing, reconciliation, restorability, exceptions, and downstream dependencies.
* Perform technical analysis of complex data issues and distinguish source-data, transformation, configuration, platform, and infrastructure causes.

**Batch Operations, Monitoring and Support**

* Own batch-flow visibility, operational monitoring, issue triage, and technical coordination for failed or delayed integrations.
* Create and maintain batch runbooks, support procedures, error-log libraries, escalation paths, and recovery instructions that are specific to the implemented landscape.
* Lead root-cause analysis for recurring incidents and convert findings into preventive controls, automation, or design improvements.
* Support production releases, continuous improvement through Change Requests, and transition to steady-state operations, including knowledge transfer to data and support teams.

**Technical Development and Automation**

* Use Python where appropriate to develop plug-ins, procedures, utilities, validations, and automation that complement o9 configuration and integration capabilities.
* Apply sound software-engineering practices including version control, modular design, code review, logging, exception handling, testing, and technical documentation.
* Collaborate with functional experts to translate planning requirements into safe and maintainable technical extensions without compromising platform standards.

**Quality, Security and Release Governance**

* Define and apply technical quality gates for integration design, code, configuration, testing evidence, deployment readiness, and documentation completeness.
* Prepare unit, system-integration, regression, performance, and reconciliation test scenarios in collaboration with QA and functional teams.
* Ensure secure handling of credentials, access, data transfers, service accounts, certificates, and environment-specific configuration in line with approved policies.
* Identify technical debt, performance risks, and single points of failure, and maintain a prioritized improvement roadmap.

**Agile Delivery and Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Author and refine technical user stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, estimates, dependencies, and implementation plans.
* Participate in sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and defect-triage forums.
* Communicate technical risks, decisions, and recovery options clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Mentor less-experienced technical resources and strengthen internal integration capability through structured knowledge sharing.

**What We're Looking For**
**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Minimum 5 years of relevant professional experience, including at least 1 year of hands-on o9 INT3.0 integration experience.
* Recent delivery experience on o9 implementation projects, with demonstrated ownership of Integration 3.0 work and implementation outcomes.
* Strong practical knowledge of o9 INT3.0 concepts, tools, deployment patterns, batch processing, operational monitoring, and troubleshooting.
* Hands-on experience integrating with SAP or other ERP systems, data platforms, middleware, file-transfer services, and cloud environments.
* Strong SQL and data-engineering fundamentals, including data modeling, mapping, transformation, reconciliation, dependency management, and performance analysis.
* Working Python programming experience for plug-ins, procedures, validation utilities, or automation.
* Experience with APIs, structured files, secure file transfer, authentication methods, scheduling or orchestration, and environment promotion practices.
* Experience producing technical integration designs, data-flow diagrams, interface specifications, deployment plans, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Demonstrated ability to work in agile delivery environments using tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Certifications**

* o9 Integration 3.0 (INT3.0) certification is required; equivalent demonstrable expertise must be supported by recent project evidence.
* Additional o9 technical, platform, configuration, performance, or analytics certifications are valued.
* Relevant cloud, data engineering, integration, security, agile, or project-management certifications are advantageous.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience in global IBP or supply-chain planning programs spanning Demand Planning, Supply Planning, S&OP/IBP, and KPI or analytics solutions.
* Experience operating in a Center of Excellence model and transitioning implementation knowledge into internal support ownership.
* Exposure to customer-managed cloud or Azure-based deployments, enterprise identity integration, and secure data-transfer patterns.
* Experience improving batch performance, observability, error handling, and resilience in business-critical planning landscapes.
* Ability to contribute across integration architecture and hands-on delivery while maintaining a clear separation between standard platform configuration and custom development.

**Behavioural And Leadership Skills**

* Technical ownership: takes accountability for outcomes, follows issues through resolution, and makes risks visible early.
* Analytical problem solving: structures ambiguous technical problems, tests hypotheses, and produces evidence-based conclusions.
* Communication: explains complex integration behavior to both engineering teams and business stakeholders in clear language.
* Collaboration: works effectively across functional consultants, architects, data teams, infrastructure, security, vendors, and business users.
* Quality mindset: values documentation, repeatability, traceability, and sustainable support over short-term fixes.
* Coaching: strengthens team capability through reviews, standards, reusable examples, and hands-on knowledge transfer.

**Success Measures**

* Reliable execution of scheduled integrations with clear monitoring, ownership, and recovery procedures.
* Reduced recurrence and resolution time of integration incidents through root-cause elimination and better operational knowledge.
* Complete, current, and usable technical documentation for interfaces, batches, error handling, deployments, and support.
* Consistent compliance with design, security, testing, release, and support-readiness standards.
* Effective transfer of integration knowledge from project resources into the IBP CoE and support organization.
* Timely delivery of approved enhancements and automation with measurable improvement in platform operability and team productivity.

title: Strategy Manager
description:

Department: CEO’s Office

Location: Sirakol, West Bengal

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: 7–10 years

Compensation: Upto 15 LPA

Role Overview

To drive the development, execution, monitoring and review of IAC’s organisational strategy and strategic priorities.

The role will work closely with the CEO’s Office, leadership team and departments to translate organisational priorities into measurable plans, monitor performance and ensure strategic alignment across the organisation.

This is a high-thinking, high-ownership role requiring the ability to understand IAC holistically, challenge thinking, identify strategic gaps and bring structure to complex organisational priorities.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategy & Planning

Translate IAC’s organisational strategy into strategic priorities, initiatives, departmental goals and measurable outcomes.

Lead annual and periodic strategy planning and goal-setting exercises across departments.

Work with HODs to develop goals, KPIs, action plans and timelines aligned with organisational priorities.

Identify strategic gaps, interdependencies and opportunities and provide clear recommendations to leadership.

Drive organisation-wide and cross-functional strategic initiatives.

2. Strategy & Performance Review

Own the framework for monitoring organisational and departmental performance against agreed goals, KPIs, milestones and outcomes.

Lead monthly, quarterly and annual strategy and performance reviews.

Analyse performance to identify gaps, risks, delays, dependencies and areas requiring intervention.

Recommend corrective actions and strategic interventions to leadership.

Track decisions and ensure follow-through on agreed strategic actions.

3. Strategic Reporting & Decision Support

Own the CEO’s Office reporting framework across departments.

Analyse departmental reports and convert information into key insights, exceptions, risks and areas requiring leadership attention.

Develop and maintain strategic dashboards, trackers and performance reports.

Prepare concise, decision-oriented reports, presentations and briefing materials for the CEO’s Office and leadership team.

Continuously improve systems for accurate, timely and actionable management information.

Key Outcomes

Translate IAC’s organisational strategy into clear strategic priorities, departmental goals, KPIs, action plans and measurable outcomes.

Establish and maintain an effective organisation-wide framework for monitoring strategy and performance.

Ensure regular monthly, quarterly and annual strategy and performance reviews are conducted with clear identification of gaps, risks, dependencies and required interventions.

Provide the CEO’s Office and leadership team with accurate, timely and actionable strategic reporting and decision support.

Drive alignment and follow-through on organisation-wide and cross-functional strategic initiatives.

Must-Have Requirements

MBA with strong academic/project experience and a demonstrated problem-solving and strategic thinking mindset may be considered.

7–10 years of relevant experience in strategy, management consulting, business planning, organisational performance, transformation or a similar role.

Strong strategic thinking and ability to understand the larger organisational picture.

Excellent analytical, problem-solving and structured-thinking abilities.

Strong experience in strategy execution, performance management and organisational planning.

Ability to constructively challenge senior stakeholders and influence decision-making.

Strong understanding of KPIs, performance measurement, dashboards and management reporting.

Excellent Excel/Google Sheets skills.

Exceptional written, verbal and presentation skills.

Ability to simplify complex information into clear insights and recommendations.

Strong project and stakeholder management skills.

Comfortable operating independently in an evolving organisation.

High attention to detail while maintaining focus on the larger strategic objective.

Preferred Skills

Familiarity with Power BI, data visualisation, project management and AI tools.

Experience working directly with senior leadership or CEO/Executive Offices on organisational strategy and performance.

Experience managing complex, cross-functional strategic initiatives.

Growth Opportunity

The role is positioned within the CEO’s Office and provides broad exposure to IAC’s organisational strategy, leadership priorities and cross-functional operations.

As the organisation and strategy function evolve, the role may take increasing ownership of organisation-wide strategic planning, performance management, transformation and strategic initiatives.

India Autism Center (IAC) is a not-for-profit organisation aiming to build a comprehensive ecosystem of support, training, research, and lifelong residential living solutions for individuals on the autism spectrum and their families. title: Creative / Design Head
description:
**We’re Hiring | Creative / Design Head**

Kass • Full-Time Opportunity • Kolkata

**Role :**

Creative / Design Head

**Location :**

Kolkata (Work From Office)

**Experience & Availability :**

2–3+ Years • Immediate to 30 Days

**About Kass**

Kass is a premium D2C skincare brand built around
**Bio-Intelligent Skincare -**

thoughtfully formulated solutions designed to address skin concerns at their foundation and support long-term skin health.Building a premium brand goes far beyond creating pretty graphics. It requires a distinctive visual language, a cohesive brand ecosystem, and high-velocity operational pipelines that consistently deliver theatrical-grade assets. We are looking for a
**Creative/Design Head**

who understands how modern, premium D2C brands operate, commands the production floor, and knows how to lead a multidisciplinary creative department to drive tangible brand scale.

**The Role**

As the
**Creative/Design Head**

, you will own Kass’s entire visual and creative direction across all touchpoints - digital performance campaigns, brand films, 3D simulations, physical packaging, and retail presence.You will lead, mentor, and direct a high-output multidisciplinary team (video editors, 3D motion artists and graphic designers), acting as the ultimate strategic and aesthetic filter for the brand. Beyond creative leadership, you will build and optimize the operational pipelines and automations that allow the team to scale output without sacrificing a premium, "million-dollar" brand finish.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Creative Direction & Brand Architecture**

* **Define, protect, and evolve**

  Kass’s overall visual identity and brand guidelines across digital, physical packaging, e-commerce, and offline touchpoints.
* **Translate complex, clinical, and bio-intelligent formulations**

  into sophisticated, scroll-stopping narratives and high-converting visual assets.
* Ensure every frame, static, and render meets an uncompromising, premium aesthetic standard.

**2. Multidisciplinary Team Leadership**

* **Direct, mentor, and maintain rigorous quality control**

  over a high-output creative floor comprising Video Editors, Graphic Designers and 3D Motion Artists.
* **Act as the primary strategic filter**

  for all campaigns—reviewing daily cuts, static creatives, narrative hooks, and 3D explainers to eliminate friction before deployment.
* **Plan, delegate, and manage project workflows**

  based on priorities, launch timelines, and individual strengths, fostering a culture of ownership and execution speed.

**3. Production & On-Set Command**

* **Bridge practical filmmaking with digital post-production**

  —lead on-set shoots, direct macro camera setups and lighting, and establish a rich, organic visual vocabulary for new product drops.
* **Supervise high-fidelity post-production**

  , including dynamic motion tracking, kinetic typography, and seamless 3D/CGI product integration.
* **Lead the production**

  of both top-of-funnel cinematic brand films and rapid-iteration performance creatives (Reels, Meta ads, short-form video).

**4. Pipeline Architecture & Workflow Optimization**

* **Build, maintain, and streamline**

  the department’s operational backbone, designing organizational systems and workflows that eliminate creative bottlenecks.
* **Integrate modern automation tools**

  , node-based workflows, and emerging AI technologies into daily production to exponentially scale asset variations and multiply team efficiency.
* **Collaborate closely**

  with Marketing, Performance, Product, and Operations to translate commercial goals into actionable creative solutions with minimal turnaround time.

**What We’re Looking For**

* **Proven Leadership:**

  Demonstrated track record leading, managing, and mentoring a multidisciplinary creative or design team in a high-velocity environment (D2C, agency, or high-growth consumer brand).
* **Aesthetic & Technical Mastery:**

  Advanced proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (Premiere, After Effects, Photoshop, Illustrator) with strong working knowledge of 3D workflows, motion graphics, and emerging AI creative tools.
* **On-Set Production Eye:**

  Solid understanding of cinematography, lighting, framing, and macro product shooting.
* **Systems Thinker:**

  Someone who doesn’t just design, but builds scalable pipelines, templates, and automated workflows to elevate the entire department’s output.
* **D2C Performance Sense:**

  Deep intuition for modern consumer psychology, thumb-stopping hooks, retention pacing, and conversion-focused design.
* **Education:**

  Bachelor’s degree in Fine Arts, Design, Animation, Visual Communication, or an equivalent battle-tested industry portfolio.

**Why Kass?**

At Kass, creative production is not an afterthought—it is the central engine of our brand equity and customer acquisition. If you have the vision to shape a rapidly scaling skincare brand and the operational muscle to lead a high-performing creative floor, we’d love to hear from you. 

Send your
**cv**

and
**portfolio**

**Head of Engineering for the Core Commerce Platform**

**unified, multi-modal billing platform**

* Financial Integrity & Compliance: Ensure 100% accuracy in revenue recognition (MRR/ARR) and downstream finance integrations. You will own the systems that interface with Stripe and internal financial reporting tools.

This role may also be eligible for benefits, bonuses, commissions, and equity.

title: SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
SAP Business AI (Joule and Basic ABAP) - Senior, Tax Technology Services
  
  
Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all of the Deloitte Tax LLP ("Deloitte Tax") U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn U.S. taxation, a much sought-after career option.
  
  
At Deloitte, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and add greater impact to clients by combining technology and tax technical resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
Work you’ll do
  
  
We are looking for an innovative Technical SAP ABAP on HANA, CDS, OData, RAP Plus Gen AI develop and implement systems architecture that meet business needs, along with ensuring that our clients’ can keep pace with the changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
Design, build, and support performance SAP S/4HANA extensions and services using ABAP on HANA, RESTful ABAP Programming Model (RAP), Core Data Services (CDS), and OData to enable modern Fiori/UI and integration scenarios.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best SAP Tax design for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group. You will also need to continually assess the SAP product suite and development roadmap to integrate any updated specifications and requirements into SAP system architecture.
  
  
You will also need to integrate with the wider client project team (whether that is delivered by Deloitte Consulting or another Systems Integration partner). This will involve an understanding of how the tax design interacts with other process flows and also the inter-personal skills to build the required relationships.
  
  
Key responsibilities -
  
  
ü Develop and enhance ABAP solutions on SAP S/4HANA using clean, modular, and testable patterns.
  
  
ü Build Gen AI applications and AI Agents.
  
  
ü Code Python is a plus.
  
  
ü Ability to navigate fragmented landscapes through API-calls and MCP- servers is key.
  
  
ü Build end-to-end RAP artifacts (behavior definitions/implementations, validations, determinations, actions, draft handling, locking, authorization concepts).
  
  
ü Create and optimize CDS views (interface/consumption views, associations, annotations) with strong focus on pushdown and performance.
  
  
ü Design, expose, and support OData services (preferably OData V4 via RAP; maintain OData V4 where required).
  
  
ü Implement Fiori-enablement via CDS annotations and support UI integration with SAP Fiori elements (as applicable).
  
  
ü Integrate with SAP and non-SAP systems using SAP-recommended patterns (e.g., APIs, events, messaging where applicable).
  
  
ü Apply performance tuning (SQL optimization, buffering strategy, ST05/SAT/SQLM analysis, CDS performance best practices).
  
  
ü Follow SAP extensibility guidelines (in-app/extensibility, key-user vs developer extensibility, released APIs, clean-core approach where applicable).
  
  
ü Produce technical designs, code documentation, unit tests, and participate in code reviews.
  
  
ü Support testing cycles, defect triage, hyper care, and production support with strong root-cause analysis
  
  
**Qualification And Experience Required -**
ü Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience).
  
  
ü 2-5 years of Experience in SAP or SAP4HANA.
  
  
ü Hands-on experience in building Gen AI applications, AI Agents.
  
  
ü SAP Business AI certification is a plus.
  
  
ü SAP certifications (ABAP for S/4HANA, RAP, BTP) are a plus.
  
  
ü Strong hands-on experience with ABAP in SAP S/4HANA / ABAP on HANA environments.
  
  
ü Proven delivery experience with:
  
  
ü RAP (managed/unmanaged as needed, behavior implementation, draft, authorization)
  
  
ü CDS (views, annotations, associations, table functions if needed)
  
  
ü OData service exposure and troubleshooting (RAP/OData V4 strongly preferred)
  
  
ü Strong understanding of HANA-optimized development: SQL/CDS pushdown, avoiding SELECT-in-loops, efficient joins, pagination, etc.
  
  
ü Familiarity with modern ABAP practices (e.g., ABAP OO, clean code, exception handling, unit testing mindset).
  
  
ü Experience working in Agile delivery (user stories, estimation, sprint ceremonies).
  
  
**ü Preferred / Nice To Have**
ü SAP BTP exposure (e.g., Integration Suite, API Management, Event Mesh, ABAP environment/Steampunk—if relevant).
  
  
**Preferred -**
ü BTP, Joule and SAP business AI certification.
  
  
ü Proven knowledge of Tax touchpoints within SAP.

**Manager - Interior & Finishes**

The ideal candidate should possess extensive experience in premium interiors, luxury finishes, project execution, contractor management, and client-facing project delivery.

Contractor & Vendor Management

* Review contractor performance and ensure adherence to contractual obligations.
* Resolve technical and execution-related issues on site.
* Conduct progress review meetings and monitor contractor productivity.

Cost & Commercial Control

* Monitor project budgets and financial performance of interior works.
* Review BOQs, material quantities, and procurement schedules.
* Evaluate variation orders, claims, and change requests.

Design & Technical Coordination

* Ensure design intent is maintained throughout execution.
* Resolve technical challenges and recommend suitable finishing solutions.

Health, Safety & Compliance

* Ensure compliance with health, safety, environmental, and statutory requirements.
* Promote safe work practices across all interior and finishing activities.
* Support project teams in maintaining zero-incident work environments.

Stakeholder Management

* Coordinate with clients, consultants, architects, project managers, procurement teams, and senior leadership.
* Provide regular updates on project progress, risks, quality issues, and mitigation plans.
* Ensure client expectations are met throughout project execution and handover.

Team Leadership

* Lead and mentor project engineers, site managers, finishing engineers, and contractors.
* Drive team performance through coaching, training, and regular reviews.
* Foster a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

Required Qualifications

* Bachelor's Degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management, or related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification in Project Management or Construction Management will be an added advantage.

Required Experience

* 15-20 years of experience in interior fit-outs, finishing works, and project execution.
* Proven track record of managing large-scale residential, commercial, hospitality, retail, or mixed-use developments.
* Experience handling premium and luxury interior projects is highly preferred.
* Strong exposure to contractor management, project delivery, and quality assurance.

description:
ONLY APPLY IF

3. You are willing to join immediately from our Kolkata Office

**Role Description**
The Solar O&M Engineer / AMC Rooftop Asset Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in the Greater Kolkata Area. This role is responsible for overseeing the operation and maintenance of rooftop solar assets, including planning and executing preventive and corrective maintenance activities to ensure optimal performance and uptime. Day-to-day tasks include diagnosing technical issues, coordinating troubleshooting on-site, supervising maintenance teams and vendors, and maintaining detailed records of asset performance and service activities. The role also involves conducting site inspections, preparing technical reports, ensuring adherence to safety standards and regulatory requirements, and supporting continuous improvement of O&M processes. * Relevant qualifications such as a diploma or degree in Electrical Engineering, Renewable Energy, or a related field are preferred.

* Lead a team on cutting-edge AI projects alongside leading research labs

* Shape how AI understands and processes spoken Bengali for millions of people
* Build specialized leadership and quality-assurance skills in AI data pipelines
* Potential for ongoing work and contract extension as new projects launch

KPMG in India, a professional services firm, is the Indian member firm of KPMG International and was established in September 1993. title: Fabric Manager
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Fabric Development**

* Understand buyer requirements, tech packs, fabric specifications, construction, composition, GSM, width, finish, and performance requirements.
* Source and develop fabrics as per buyer specifications and garment requirements.
* Coordinate fabric development with mills and suppliers.
* Arrange fabric swatches, hanger sets, lab dips, strike-offs, and other development submissions.
* Follow up on buyer approvals and comments and ensure timely implementation.

**2. Fabric Sourcing**

* Identify and develop reliable fabric mills and suppliers.
* Obtain quotations and negotiate fabric prices, lead times, MOQ, and payment terms.
* Compare supplier quotations and select suitable sources based on quality, price, capacity, and delivery capability.
* Maintain a database of approved mills and fabric suppliers.
* Develop alternative suppliers wherever required to reduce sourcing risks.

**3. Costing & Commercial Management**

* Prepare fabric costing based on construction, composition, GSM, width, finish, dyeing/printing, and other processes.
* Negotiate fabric prices with suppliers to achieve target costing.
* Monitor fabric price fluctuations and communicate cost impacts to the merchandising/commercial team.
* Ensure fabric purchases are commercially viable and within approved budgets.

**4. Order & Production Follow-up**

* Place fabric orders with approved suppliers after receiving necessary approvals.
* Monitor fabric booking, greige availability, dyeing, finishing, and production status.
* Maintain fabric T&A and ensure all critical dates are achieved.
* Follow up regularly with mills for production and delivery status.
* Identify potential delays and take corrective action proactively.
* Coordinate fabric delivery with factory production plans.

**5. Fabric Quality & Testing**

* Ensure bulk fabric meets approved standards and buyer requirements.
* Coordinate fabric inspection and quality evaluation with the QA/QC team.
* Follow up on fabric testing such as shrinkage, colorfastness, GSM, dimensional stability, pilling, composition, and other buyer-specific requirements.
* Resolve fabric quality issues with suppliers and ensure corrective action.
* Ensure bulk production matches approved fabric standards and hand feel.

**6. Coordination with Internal Teams**

* Work closely with garment merchandisers to understand order requirements and delivery schedules.
* Coordinate with production planning, sourcing, quality, stores, and commercial teams.
* Provide accurate fabric status updates to management.
* Ensure sufficient fabric availability before production starts.
* Coordinate fabric allocation and delivery according to production priorities.

**7. Documentation & MIS**

* Maintain accurate records of fabric enquiries, developments, approvals, orders, deliveries, and quality reports.
* Prepare regular fabric status reports and T&A updates.
* Maintain supplier performance records.
* Track pending approvals, production status, shipment schedules, and outstanding issues.
* Ensure all fabric-related documentation is properly maintained.

+ Identify potential opportunities to automate current ITDM/manual controls leveraging Oracle EBS/ERP Cloud.

Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture:**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**

title: Business Head – Skill Development (Govt, CSR & Paid Programs)
description:
**ABOUT KINGSTON EDUCATIONAL INSTITUTE**

Kingston Educational Institute (KEI) is a multidisciplinary education society operating since 2017 from a 28-acre campus in Barasat, Kolkata. KEI runs colleges in engineering, law, management, science, healthcare and polytechnic education, along with a multi-specialty hospital.

Through its skilling arm, KEI delivers government-funded, CSR-supported and fee-based skilling programs across West Bengal, Tripura, Meghalaya and other states, working with Sector Skill Councils and industry partners in healthcare, hospitality, electronics and manufacturing.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Business Head – Skill Development to own the complete P&L of our skilling vertical across three revenue streams:

- Government-sponsored skilling projects

- CSR-funded programs

- Paid, industry-linked certification courses

This is a hands-on leadership role. We want a professional who has personally handled skilling projects end to end, from bidding and sanction through mobilisation, training, assessment, placement and final payment recovery.

**Reports to: President & Secretary, KEI**

Travel: Frequent, especially to the North-East

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**P&L Ownership**

- Own annual revenue, margin and net contribution targets for the skilling vertical

- Prepare the business plan, project-wise budgets and cost-per-candidate models

- Track project-wise and centre-wise profitability monthly and fix underperforming centres or batches

**Cash Flow Management**

- Take full responsibility for the cash flow of each program: government, CSR and paid

- Prepare monthly and quarterly cash-flow forecasts for every project

- Plan working capital so every project stays funded through to completion, especially where payments come in tranches

**Accounts Receivable and Claim Recovery**

- Own accounts receivable across all programs, especially government and CSR projects

- Raise claims and invoices on time for every milestone: enrolment, training, assessment, certification, placement and retention

- Ensure complete supporting documentation: attendance, assessment results, certificates, placement and retention proofs

- Follow up with government departments, State Skill Missions and CSR funders on pending tranche releases

- Reduce outstanding dues and receivables ageing

- Submit utilisation certificates on time and coordinate with finance on reconciliation and audits

**Government Projects**

- Identify, bid for and win projects under PMKVY, DDU-GKY, PM-AJAY, NAPS, State Skill Missions and similar schemes

- Prepare proposals, DPRs and tender documents

- Ensure full compliance with scheme guidelines, Skill India Digital/SDMS and other portals, and inspection norms

**CSR Programs**

- Build relationships with corporate CSR teams, PSUs and foundations

- Design fundable CSR proposals with clear outcomes and impact metrics

- Deliver CSR projects to agreed milestones and submit impact reports

**Paid Programs**

- Launch and scale fee-based certification and upskilling courses

- Design job-linked curricula with industry partners and Centres of Excellence

- Drive enrolments and ensure fee collection as per schedule

**End-to-End Operations and Placement**

- Oversee the full project cycle: centre readiness, mobilisation, training, assessment, certification, placement and post-placement tracking

- Conduct regular field visits and keep every centre audit-ready

- Achieve placement and retention targets as per scheme norms

- Build employer networks across healthcare, hospitality, retail, electronics, manufacturing and logistics

**Compliance and Partnerships**

- Maintain zero tolerance for malpractice and protect KEI's standing with every funding agency

- Manage inspections, monitoring visits and audits

- Manage relationships with Sector Skill Councils (THSC, HSSC, ESSC and others), NSDC and state departments

**Team Leadership and Reporting**

- Lead project managers, centre heads, trainers, mobilisers, MIS and placement teams

- Set targets, review performance and establish SOPs

- Maintain a live MIS dashboard and present a monthly business review to the President

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

- 10+ years in the skill development sector, with at least 4 years in a P&L or business-head role

- Hands-on experience running skilling projects end to end, from sanction to final payment closure

- Proven record of winning and executing government skilling projects (PMKVY, DDU-GKY or State Skill Mission)

- Experience raising and managing CSR funding

- Strong understanding of scheme financials, claims cycles and compliance

- Track record of recovering receivables from government departments and CSR funders

- Experience managing multi-state operations and large field teams

- A professional, dedicated approach with high standards of integrity

- Graduate/Postgraduate degree; MBA preferred

- Experience in the North-East and knowledge of Bengali or Hindi are advantages

**ELIGIBILITY AND INTEGRITY CONDITIONS**

- Must not have worked with any organisation that has been blacklisted or debarred under any government or CSR skilling program

- Must not personally have been named in any blacklisting, debarment or malpractice finding

- Shortlisted candidates must submit a signed self-declaration and clear background verification

**COMPENSATION**

- Fixed monthly salary, commensurate with experience

- Variable pay linked to project completion and payments actually received by KEI

- Details of the variable structure will be shared with shortlisted candidates

**SELECTION PROCESS**

1. CV screening and telephonic discussion

2. Technical interview on scheme operations, claims and compliance ,networks and non-market strategy the candidate brings on board.

3. Business case presentation (P&L and cash-flow plan for a sample project)

4. Final interview with the President & Secretary of KEI

5. Self-declaration, background verification and offer

Kingston Educational Institute is an equal opportunity employer.

description:
**Job Title-**

**Function**

**About DHL Blue Dart Express India:**
**Blue Dart Express Limited**
, a listed company, is a leader in courier, integrated air express package distribution, and eCommerce in South Asia, offering a wide range of logistics solutions. Founded in 1983, it is recognised for reliable, time-bound, and secure delivery services across 55,000+ locations in India as well as internationally. Its competencies span across evaluation and contracting, planning and transition, delivery and execution, and specific service capabilities. We pride ourselves on innovation, digitalization, service excellence, and creating long-term partnerships with our clients, enabling businesses to thrive in the fast-paced logistics environment and ever-evolving supply-chains. It wholly-owns India’s only scheduled air cargo airline, Blue Dart Aviation Limited, since May 1994, and the Concorde Air Logistics Limited, a transport, storage, and communications business, since May 2004.
  
  
Blue Dart Express Limited is a part of the DHL Group's DHL eCommerce division, leveraging this global logistics leader’s network across 220 countries and territories to provide comprehensive express and logistics solutions to our clients. Our robust network and unmatched infrastructure have positioned the Blue Dart brand as a key India-grown logistics player with an unmatched and phenomenal global outreach rooted in the DHL brand of its majority shareholder.
  
  
We are proud to be consistently ranked among
**India’s Top 100 Great Places to Work**
, combining it with DHL Group’s Top Employer certification. Being an
**Employer of Choice**
is not just a goal; it’s a fundamental part of who we are, committed to creating a workplace where people are valued, empowered, and wear the sobriquet “Blue Darter” with honour.
  
  
If you are looking to join a purpose-led, people-first, company that shapes India’s supply-chains with integrity and safety,
**Blue Dart is where you belong**
. Blue Dart offers competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, access to cross-functional, succession planning and global career paths, and strong culture of recognition.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
The Service Centre Incharge – Operations (Non Metro / BDO) is responsible for managing end-to-end operational activities across one or more assigned Non Metro Branches, Business Development Offices (BDOs) or Service Centres. The role oversees inbound and outbound shipment processing, pickup and delivery coordination, customer service support, manpower deployment and operational governance to ensure seamless day-to-day operations.
  
  
Reporting to the Assistant Manager – Operations (Area Operations), the incumbent provides frontline leadership to operational teams, ensuring adherence to service commitments, operational productivity, safety, compliance and Blue Dart's Standard Operating Procedures while delivering consistent customer experience and supporting business continuity across the assigned locations.
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
To lead and manage end-to-end shift operations across assigned Non Metro Branches and BDO locations by ensuring efficient shipment processing, timely pickups and dispatches, optimal workforce utilisation, operational discipline and consistent service delivery while maintaining safety, compliance and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Roles & Responsibilities:**
**End-to-End Shift Operations**

* Lead and supervise all inbound, outbound, pickup and dispatch activities during the assigned shift.
* Ensure timely receipt, processing, sorting, scanning, loading and dispatch of shipments in line with operational timelines.
* Monitor operational workflow across assigned BDOs and Service Centres to ensure seamless shipment movement.
* Ensure operational readiness to manage daily volumes, peak periods and contingency situations.

**Shipment Processing & Service Quality**

* Ensure accurate scanning, sorting, bagging, routing and reconciliation of all shipments.
* Minimise shipment exceptions, operational delays and service failures through proactive monitoring.
* Ensure adherence to network cut-off timelines and service commitments.
* Escalate damaged, short, discrepant or delayed shipments promptly and ensure timely resolution.

**Pickup & Delivery Operations**

* Coordinate daily pickup and delivery activities to achieve defined service levels.
* Monitor route readiness and shipment movement to ensure timely customer service.
* Support resolution of operational issues impacting deliveries and pickups.
* Coordinate with transport, network and customer service teams to ensure smooth operational execution.

**People Leadership & Shift Management**

* Plan and deploy manpower effectively across operational activities and assigned locations.
* Lead, coach and guide Ops Staff, Senior Ops Staff and Territory Service Representatives during the shift.
* Conduct daily shift briefings covering operational priorities, safety and productivity expectations.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, discipline and workforce productivity while promoting teamwork and accountability.

**Safety, Compliance & Operational Discipline**

* Ensure adherence to Blue Dart Standard Operating Procedures, operational guidelines and statutory requirements.
* Promote a safe working environment by ensuring compliance with safety standards and security procedures.
* Ensure prescribed uniform, identity card and personal protective equipment are used wherever applicable.
* Maintain high standards of housekeeping, operational discipline and ethical conduct across all assigned locations.

**Operational Governance & Continuous Improvement**

* Monitor daily operational performance and productivity against defined targets.
* Ensure timely completion of operational documentation, system updates and shift reports.
* Conduct effective shift handovers and escalate operational risks or service issues promptly.
* Support implementation of operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Work closely with Customer Service, Fleet, Security, Network Operations and Area Operations teams to ensure seamless service delivery.
* Build effective working relationships across internal teams and operational partners.
* Support implementation of new operational initiatives, business priorities and process improvements.
* Act as the primary operational contact for assigned locations during the shift.

**Qualifications & Experience:**
**Education**
:
  
  
  

* Graduate in any discipline from a recognized university.

**Experience**
:
  
  
  

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in courier, express logistics, transportation, warehousing, distribution or supply chain operations.
* Experience in managing end-to-end Service Centre operations, including inbound, outbound, pickup and delivery activities.
* Proven experience in leading frontline operational teams and coordinating shift operations.
* Exposure to shipment processing, scanning, sorting, reconciliation, dispatch and customer service operations.
* Experience working with operational systems, handheld scanners and operational reporting will be an advantage.

**Skills & Capabilities:**
**Technical Skills:**

* End-to-End Shift Operations Management
* Service Centre Operations
* Shipment Processing & Dispatch Management
* Pickup & Delivery Coordination
* Workforce Planning & Shift Management
* Productivity & Resource Utilization
* Operational Reporting & MIS
* Operational Systems & Scanner Usage
* Safety & Regulatory Compliance
* Process Improvement & Operational Excellence

**Key Competencies:**

* Operational Leadership
* Planning & Organising
* Decision Making
* Customer Focus
* Team Leadership & Coaching
* Problem Solving
* Accountability & Ownership
* Communication & Collaboration
* Integrity & Ethical Conduct
* Operational Discipline
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

**KPIs**
Operational Performance
  
  
Inbound & Outbound SLA adherence; On-time shipment processing; Dispatch timeliness
  
  
Service Quality
  
  
Shipment accuracy; Scanning compliance; Reduction in shipment exceptions and operational errors

**Why join DHL Blue Dart?**
When you join us, you’re not just taking a job—you’re becoming part of a purpose-led movement that’s reshaping the future of logistics across India and the world. At Blue Dart, we don’t just deliver parcels—we deliver excellence, innovation, and opportunity every day.

As a Manager, Human-Centered Change Management, you will serve as a strategic advisor, partnering with Salesforce customers to optimize platform value realization through the design and implementation of change strategies that prioritize the human aspect of transformative change. Working collaboratively with customers and Salesforce delivery teams, you will drive impactful team dynamics, cultivate awareness, and secure alignment with a unified change vision. Additionally, you will provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to members of the project team.

* Partner with customers to develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies aligned with organizational goals and Salesforce platform implementation.
* Analyze the human impact of technological changes and develop adaptive strategies to address organizational challenges.

**Proactive Engagement And Team Building**

* Proactively foster high-impact team dynamics, building awareness and securing buy-in for shared change objectives.
* Collaborate closely with customers and Salesforce delivery teams to ensure alignment and commitment to the change vision.

* Design and implement tailored training programs for stakeholders at all levels to ensure effective utilization of Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to align user experience design with change management strategies, ensuring user-centric adoption of Salesforce solutions.

**Oversight And Mentoring**

* Provide oversight, coaching, and mentoring to project team members, guiding them in executing change management strategies effectively.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and development within the project team.
