title: Salesforce Field Service Architect
description:
**Description**
Our Field Service Professional Services team works across technology and business stakeholders to usher customers into the next phase of their business transformation journey and achieve innovative outcomes that craft the future.
  
  
Technical Architect successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers. These technologies include--but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce.com products and APIs, Apex/Visualforce, Lightning, mobile development technologies, and integration/ETL technologies.
  
  
As a core part of this role, you will realize solutions for our customers by focusing on consultancy, technical development & delivery for the customers and partners to solve critically meaningful business challenges using Salesforce’s Field Service Platform (SFS). Salesforce FS product provides FSM solutions for a wide variety of customer verticals and ecosystem(s) like Telecom, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Manufacturing, Finance etc.
  
  
You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, deliverables, and set and manage expectations
* Drive Enterprise AI Architecture by designing and integrating scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within custom Salesforce environments, optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits
* Lead technical design sessions; architect and document technical solutions aligned with client business objectives; identify gaps between client's current and desired end states, using advanced LLMs like Claude to review architectural assumptions and simulate system edge cases
* Champion an AI-first delivery methodology, utilizing advanced AI tools, developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude), and agentic evaluation frameworks to accelerate implementation across projects
* Translate business requirements into well-architected solutions that best leverage the Salesforce platform
* Provide oversight and governance of Salesforce projects
* Follow and help define coding standards. Lead code reviews during projects to ensure quality and appropriate design patterns are followed
* Manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migration elements of a Salesforce implementation
* Maintain a target billable utilization aligned to the role
* Ability to understand a project and deep dive to debug issues
* From time-to-time, the TA may be expected to partake in other pre-sales activities such as discovery and technical deep-dive sessions, Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development with prospects
* Liaise with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations
* Travels to client sites for projects, estimated 50-75%

**Requirements**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience required. Experience will be evaluated based on the core proficiencies for the role (e.g. extracurricular leadership roles, military experience, volunteer roles, work experience, etc.)
* 9-14 years CRM experience with a minimum of 6 years on the Salesforce platform
* Expert level understanding of End-to-End Field Service Implementation
* Good understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Marketing, and Community Clouds
* Understanding of systems architecture and ability to design scalable performance-driven solutions
* Understanding of key design patterns and large data volume limitations and best practices
* Understanding of data sharing and visibility considerations and how these play into platform architecture
* Familiarity with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth)
* Knowledge of data integration tools and experience integrating Salesforce with different business systems (ETL, CPQ, marketing automation, reporting, etc.)
* Strong understanding of environment management, release management, code versioning best practices, and deployment methodologies
* Experience with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL)
* Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
* Strong background in design/development of large web-based systems, or complete software product lifecycle exposure
* Active Salesforce certifications or ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire

title: Salesforce Technical Manager - Core Data
description:
**Description**
Salesforce is currently seeking a Manager, Technical Consulting to join our Global Delivery Centre (GDC) team. Our Manager, Technical Consulting role plays a meaningful part in managing, training, and building the careers of our technical consulting team.
  
  
In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Core Data practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.
  
  
This role is 50% billable and in addition to team leadership, you will work with our customers and partners as a Data Architect to solve critically important business challenges using Salesforce’s platform and core data fundamentals.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* You will be required to deliver technical work (as a data/technical architect) on billable projects at 50% utilization and balance that with leading your team of Technical Consultants/Architects

+ Define and govern the overall data architecture strategy across Salesforce orgs, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with enterprise data standards
+ Own end-to-end data migration strategy and execution — covering discovery, profiling, cleansing, transformation, load, and validation
+ Advise clients on Salesforce object model best practices — standard vs. custom objects, relationships (lookup, master-detail, polymorphic), and schema design
+ Lead decisions on data access patterns, sharing model, OWD, role hierarchy, and field-level security as they relate to data architecture
+ Establish data governance frameworks, data ownership models, and data stewardship practices
+ Design solutions across multi-org, multi-cloud, and hybrid data environments

* You’ll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.
* Identify and lead internal critical initiatives to grow the practice; serving as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise, championing an AI-First Delivery & Engineering model across your delivery team.
* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.
* Lead a project team of developers focused on driving optimized solutions for our clients leveraging Salesforce Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Industries Cloud and Experience Cloud, guiding teams on the effective use of AI development tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to maintain delivery speed and code health.
* Ensure the success of these teams while securing the highest CSAT and business outcomes, focusing on Performance Evaluation & ROI by defining metric frameworks to measure the business value of client AI workloads.
* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party stakeholders.
* Champion an AI-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.
* Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high-quality customer solutions.
* Highlight and manage risk areas in the solution in a proactive manner, and commit to seeing an issue through to completion.

**Minimum Requirements**

* 10-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors, with a strong data focus.
* 5+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Proficiency with data integration tools (Informatica, Talend, or similar)
* Solid understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, SOQL, Python, data loading tools, and Salesforce governor limits.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly CDP)
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, Salesforce Industries Cloud (Comms, H&I or FSC OR RCA/RCB) with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.
* Data Architecture and Management (Must have)
* Integration Architecture (Must have)
* Data360 and Agentblazer Legend
* Architectural Design Patterns
* Sharing and Visibility (Good to have)
* Platform Security (Good to have)
* Identity and Access Management / Integration Security (Good to have)
* Proficiency in English.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Salesforce Certification Preferred (Admin, App Builder, Sales, and Service Clouds, Application Architect)
* Thorough individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies, specifically keeping pace with AI-assisted delivery trends and data compliance practices.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience.
* A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles.
* Proven ability to analyze, design, and optimize business processes via technology and integration.
* Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems.
* Adept at navigating/mediating conflict and fostering healthy dialogue.
* Strong interpersonal skills - nurture effective working relationships with others.
* Exceptional analytical skills - experience overseeing and managing business metrics, productivity, AI evaluation metrics, and outcomes.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
This document covers two role profiles for Finacle Core Banking transformation programs: Techno-Functional Consultant – Manager and Business Analyst – Senior.
  
  
**Role Profile: Business Analyst – Senior**
**Role Summary**
We are seeking a functional and techno-functional Business Analyst with prior experience in Infosys Finacle Core Banking. The role focuses on requirements management, solution mapping, process modelling, data analysis, integration and API requirements, interface specifications, and banking data structures across Finacle implementation, transformation, migration, upgrade and modernization programs.
  
  
**Role Business Analyst – Finacle Core Banking**
**Experience 5+ years in banking; 3+ years in business analysis**
**Domain Retail and Corporate Banking, Lending, Payments and Cards, Compliance, Treasury, Investment Banking and Wealth Management**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Work as a Business Analyst in banking transformation projects.
* Conduct requirements workshops and stakeholder discussions with business and technology teams.
* Gather, analyze, document and validate business, functional and non-functional requirements.
* Prepare BRDs, FSDs, user stories, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents and test scenarios.
* Perform solution mapping and gap analysis between business requirements and Finacle capabilities.
* Coordinate with Solution Architecture, Development, Testing, Infrastructure and Vendor teams.
* Support data mapping, migration analysis, integration requirements and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure alignment among business requirements, solution design, testing activities and business objectives.
* Support SIT, UAT, Simulation, Go-Live and Hypercare from business and functional perspectives.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong understanding of Finacle Core Banking functionality and ecosystem, including parameterization and configuration impacts.
* Experience in requirements elicitation, business process modelling, functional design, fit-gap analysis and process transformation.
* Understanding of APIs, web services, interface specifications, integration touchpoints, banking data models and data mapping.
* Experience supporting data migration, reconciliation, validation, reporting, audit and regulatory data requirements.
* Exposure to digital and mobile banking, channel integrations, microservices, cloud, DevOps and modern banking technologies.
* Experience designing Java-based extensions, services and integration flows using Finacle Integrator and API Hub on Finacle 11x.
* Experience developing and customizing front-end interfaces, menus and client-side components for Finacle 11x.
* Strong knowledge of Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Payments, Lending, Treasury, Liquidity, Finance, Risk, Compliance and regulatory processes.
* Client-facing communication, documentation, presentation, analytical and problem-solving skills.

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* MBA, MCA, BE, BTech or equivalent qualification with banking industry experience.
* Business Analysis or banking domain certification such as CBAP, CCBA or ECBA.
* Experience with Agile, Scrum and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
* Exposure to Finacle Digital Banking, Payments, API Banking and Open Banking initiatives.
* Familiarity with SQL, reporting, reconciliation, UML, BPMN, Jira, Confluence or Azure DevOps.
* Experience using Generative AI and prompt engineering.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
Our Commitment
  
  
**As a commitment,**
we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How To Apply**
If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy. Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits. “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Global Resilience Risk Specialist DevSecOps Senior Manager
description:

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
  
  
HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Provide specialist, actionable and contextual guidance on Technology Risk, enabling business growth while ensuring risks remain within appetite. Review and challenge the design and operating effectiveness of controls relating to Technology Risk. Support Risk Stewards in assessing internal and external events, providing insights and lessons learned relevant to Technology Risk controls.
* Influence and guide stakeholders across all lines of defense so they can fulfil their roles and manage resilience risk in line with Group frameworks and stated appetite. Build and maintain relationships with external partners, regulators, industry bodies and other relevant stakeholders to remain current on Technology Risk developments. Collaborate with the wider GRR team to align specialist input, share insights and support consistent risk management outcomes.
* Partner with GRR Business & Functions teams and 1LOD to identify, assess, mitigate, monitor and report Technology Risks. Support implementation of Internal Audit and GRR recommendations, including improvements to the use of the Risk Framework for Technology Risk. Maintain awareness of GRR risk impacts associated with the role and act in a manner that reflects GRR risk considerations.
* Comply with HSBC internal control standards by following relevant procedures, maintaining appropriate records and implementing internal and external audit actions, including those raised by regulators, in a timely manner. Operate on a bank-wide basis, collaborating closely with GRR peers and providing RR technical advice and guidance to support their relationship management responsibilities.
* Provide technical advice and operate globally so stakeholders understand the Technology Risk control environment and related assessments, proportionate to the scale and nature of operations. Support GRR Business & Functions teams in explaining, in non-technical terms, the impact of issues, events and top or emerging risks that may require changes to controls, resources or business operations to remain within risk appetite.
* Support GRR Business & Functions teams in ensuring risk and control owners have a clear understanding of the effectiveness of the current control environment. Monitor the external environment to identify emerging Technology Risks early and provide detailed guidance on the controls required to mitigate them, supported by relevant cross-organization and industry relationships.
* Deliver tailored Technology Risk expertise to enable 1LOD to deploy and operate key mitigating controls effectively. Provide technical guidance to support the development and completion of GRR and regulatory reporting obligations, including RAS, top and emerging risks, risk profile reporting, RMM and Board reporting where relevant. Challenge and influence stakeholders to ensure specialist advice and guidance is understood, accepted and acted upon. Partner with relevant stakeholders to strengthen risk management culture and embed effective risk behaviors.
* Work closely with GRR Business & Functions teams and wider specialist teams to align priorities and deliver consistent outcomes. Promote diversity and demonstrate behaviors consistent with HSBC’s brand and organizational values. Work independently, prioritizing time and focusing across multiple technologies, stakeholders and deliverables. Balance the pace of technology adoption with the need to identify, assess and mitigate associated risks.
* Provide independent oversight and challenge across the SDLC (Software development lifecycle) or DevOps Environment - from development and testing through CI/CD (Continuous integration and Continuous Deployment) build and deployment - ensuring controls are effective in practice, not just by design.
* Assess whether security, quality, and release controls, including handling of Free and opensource (FOSS) components, keep pace with the speed of modern software delivery. Engage with engineering and platform teams to identify control gaps and drive timely remediation. Stay ahead of emerging risks from AI-assisted development and automation, ensuring existing DevOps/SDLC policies evolve to remain effective as these tools become part of the delivery process. Support continuous uplift of the control framework in line with evolving technology and regulatory expectations.

**To Be Successful You Will**

This role bridges business, actuarial, and technical teams to ensure accurate, compliant, and auditable migration of in\-force policy data, values, and transaction history from source to target systems.
   

  

 Key Roles \& Responsibilities
   

  

**Conversion Strategy \& Governance**
* Define the end\-to\-end conversion approach: crosswalk methodology, data mapping standards, tolerance thresholds, and reconciliation framework between legacy and target platforms.
* Own the conversion playbook — cutover strategy (big\-bang vs. phased/wave\-based), fallback/rollback plans, and freeze\-period governance.
* Establish data lineage documentation and version\-controlled mapping specs for audit and regulatory traceability.


**Business \& Technical Bridge**
* Translate legacy policy administration rules (billing, values, riders, beneficiaries, agent/commission structures) into target system configuration requirements.
* Partner with actuarial, IT, and QA teams to validate converted policy values (cash value, reserves, death benefit, surrender values) against source\-of\-truth calculations.

title: Delivery Head
description:
**Global Delivery Head – Majorly Product Implementation** 




  





**Company:** 
 RS Software (India) Ltd.
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata, West Bengal, India
 



**Reporting to:** 
 Chief Operating Officer
 



**Preferred Experience:** 
 20 \- 25 years
 



  





**Company Overview** 




 RS Software builds global, national and enterprise payment platforms, and has presence in four continents. The product suite combines knowledge systems built over 30 years, delivering mission\-critical payment solutions that combine innovation and entrepreneurship to create the new gold standard for digital payments. With approximately 40% of the global digital payment volumes in 2021 processed on platforms built by RS Software, the vision is to deliver Payments at the Speed of Thought. We are in a phase of rapid global expansion, and our success is directly tied to our ability to deliver flawless product implementations that drive immediate client value and long\-term partnership.
 



 RS Software is focused on the global payments modernization market, providing large\-scale, high\-performance payment systems, serving central Infrastructures, financial institutions, payment network providers, payment processors and software companies providing products to the payment industry. The company's product suite offers ISO 20022 ready, open payments architecture using a cloud\-based microservices framework \- optimizing costs, seamless integrations with commoditized products, and accelerating the pace of adoption.
 



 The company’s solutions today are installed in 12 of the top 20 banks in India, and the four major platforms built by RS Software cumulatively process annually 350\+ billion transactions world\-wide, giving the company a rare track record in the payments domain. RS Software’s product suite is getting recognized in some important markets, which is creating strategic partnerships, the foundation for the company’s long\-term growth.
 



 RS Software has bult India’s digital payment infrastructure, the three major payment platforms, which are transforming the lives of a billion\+ people.
 


* Instant digital payment platform (UPI)
* Bill payment platform \- Bharat Bill Payment System (BBPS)
* Enterprise Fraud and Risk Management (EFRM)



  





**Position Summary** 




 We are seeking a strategic and dynamic Global Product Delivery Head to lead the worldwide implementation of RS Software’s product suite. Based in Kolkata, the role is pivotal in ensuring end\-to\-end rollout, configuration, integration, monitoring progress with robust KPI’s, and adoption of our products at client sites across the globe.
 



 Customer engagement begins in pre\-sales with identifying requirements, assessing gaps between standard product features and custom needs, accurate scoping, resourcing, project planning, and pricing.
 



 As RS Software evolves into a true global organization with an MNC culture, the delivery of high\-quality, defect\-free products on time is non\-negotiable. This position goes beyond traditional project management—it demands a deep understanding of product\-led growth, scalable implementation methodologies, and a passion for enabling clients to achieve their business outcomes through our technology.
 



 Trust built through expertise, quality, and prompt delivery is key to this role. Each customer interaction should result in references, advocacy, and growth opportunities.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Leadership qualities as part of Senior Leadership Team (SLT)** 



* Demonstrate executive presence by maintaining passion, positivity, and a proactive attitude. Effective leadership is evidenced through one's influence on others rather than by title or tenure, and includes motivating colleagues through commitment, determination, and clear communication.
* Lead with conviction, authority, full accountability, and complete ownership. Set an example by being the first to take action in alignment with expectations for others.
* Foster unity, teamwork, and collaboration among peers.
* For each member of the SLT, prioritize RS Software first, employees second, team members third, and individual interests last. Every challenge faced by RS Software is considered the responsibility of all SLT members.
* Adopt a broad, deep, and forward\-thinking approach to strategy, planning, and execution. Apply detailed analysis and the SMART principles, measuring how time is spent and focusing on results and impact. Communicate with accuracy, clarity, and conciseness.
* Demonstrates high energy, passion, desire to learn and excel.



  





**People Leadership and Talent Magnetism** 



* Inspires and nurtures high\-performing teams through mentorship, empowerment, and clarity of purpose. Attracts and retains diverse top talent across geographies, gender, experience levels, and competitive organizations. Holds end\-to\-end accountability for top\-talent outcomes—from recruitment and successful onboarding to continuous development, growth through role rotation or linear progression, and long\-term retention.
* Foster a culture of deep product and domain expertise, client\-centricity, proactive problem\-solving, ownership and accountability.
* Work closely with RS School Of Payments and Product Engineering teams to continuously uplift the team's skills on new technology, innovation, domain knowledge, product features and implementation of best practices.
* Builds brand visibility along with Marketing for the company’s delivery excellence and thought leadership.
* Leads by example in embracing Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion, including gender balance and time\-zone diversity, with integrity, transparency, and respect.



  





**Product Implementation Strategy \& Scalability** 



* Develop and execute a global product implementation strategy that supports rapid, scalable, and repeatable deployments.
* Design and refine a standardized, yet flexible, implementation methodology (e.g., a "Product Implementation Playbook") tailored for SaaS and on\-premises deployments.
* Drive initiatives to reduce Time\-to\-Value (TTV) for new clients and improve overall implementation efficiency.
* Device a framework of working alongside local or global partners, where the entire scope of work is divided according to the strengths of the front\-end partner (where applicable) and yet not compromising on quality and timely delivery. IP and source code need to be always protected.



  





**Global Delivery Leadership, KPI’s \& Execution** 



* Own the end\-to\-end delivery lifecycle for all product implementations, from kick\-off to go\-live and hyper\-care, ensuring they are on time, within scope, and on budget.
* Provide senior leadership oversight to a globally distributed delivery organization, including Implementation Managers, Solution Architects, and Consultants, ensuring alignment, capability building, and consistent execution standards.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) specific to product implementation, such as implementation cycle time, go\-live success rate, and initial client satisfaction. KPI’s need to be across all levels and all functions of delivery. Early flags should be raised for any deviation from timelines, quality controls, resourcing, project costs, etc.
* Ensure rigorous quality, time, scope, and cost controls are embedded into delivery processes, with a strong focus on predictability, scalability, and execution of excellence.



  





**Cross\-Functional Collaboration** 



* Act as the critical bridge between the Delivery organization and Product Management/Engineering teams.
* Systematically channel client feedback and field insights from implementations back to the product team to influence the product roadmap.
* Work closely with the Sales and Pre\-Sales teams to scope new implementation engagements (SOW, time, quality, resourcing, costs, impact to customers’ business) accurately, setting correct client expectations.



  





**Client, Partner Success \& Relationship Management** 



* Serve as the ultimate escalation point for critical issues during the Scoping, Proposal, Development and Implementation phase, ensuring swift resolution and preserving client and partner trust.
* Build strong, advisory\-level relationships with key client and partner stakeholders involved in the end\-to\-end process. Customer relationships should be both with Business as well as Technology leadership.
* Ensure a seamless handover from the implementation team to the ongoing Customer Success/Support team post go\-live.



  





**Qualifications and Experience** 



* A minimum of 25 years of experience in IT delivery, with at least 10 years in a leadership role focused on the implementation of commercial software products (SaaS or on\-premises).
* Proven track record of successfully leading the global rollout and implementation of a complex B2B software product suite.
* Deep domain knowledge in the Financial Services, Banking, or Payments industry is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in building and scaling repeatable implementation methodologies and playbooks.
* Strong financial acumen with P\&L management experience for a delivery unit.



  





**Essential Skills and Competencies** 




**Product\-Centric Mindset:** 
 Deep understanding of the software product lifecycle and the unique challenges of product implementation vs. custom development.
 



 Implementation Methodology Expertise: Proven expertise in frameworks for implementation (e.g., own methodology, Agile Implementation, etc.).
 



**Influential Leader:** 
 Ability to inspire global teams and collaborate effectively with R\&D and Product Management.
 



**Client \& Stakeholder Management:** 
 Excellent client\-facing and communication skills, with experience managing senior business and technology stakeholders, including C\-level interactions.
 



 Strategic Problem Solver: Adept at navigating product\-related challenges, configuration complexities, and integration hurdles.
 



**Global Operator:** 
 Experience managing distributed teams and implementing products for international clients.
 



**Commercial \& Financial Acumen:** 
 Strong understanding of delivery economics, including effort estimation, resourcing, cost control, and margin management.

title: Startup Portfolio Managers
description:
IIM Calcutta Innovation Park (IIMCIP) is a national, leading social\-impact incubator committed to building an inclusive and innovation\-driven entrepreneurial ecosystem across India. Established in 2014 as a Section 8 company under the aegis of the Indian Institute of Management Calcutta, IIMCIP holds the formal recognition as a Technology Business Incubator by the Department of Science and Technology, Government of India, and is driven by three pillars:
 


* Developing an entrepreneurship ecosystem – By addressing the ecosystem gaps inunderserved regions, enabling sustainable, impact\-driven businesses.
* Catalysing innovation and nurturing startups – By empowering entrepreneurs with innovation in their idea, product, service, process or delivery that solves an existing problem.
* Enabling women entrepreneurs – By championing inclusiveness in the entrepreneurialEcosystem.



  





 Over the years, IIMCIP has emerged as a trusted knowledge and implementation partner for governments, corporates, PSUs, academia, investors and ecosystem enablers, such as the Department of Science and Technology (DST), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY), National Rural Livelihoods Mission (NRLM), the North Eastern Council (NEC), the Tata Sons, Pernod Ricard India Foundation, Balmer Lawrie, HDFC Bank and Maruti Suzuki India Ltd, to name a few.
 



  





 We are seeking Portfolio Managers to manage our early\-stage startup portfolio; monitor company progress and ensure that agreed milestones are met.
 



  





 We are seeking Kolkata based applicants with interest in nurturing and empowering aspiring entrepreneurs. Ideally 3\-5 years of relevant experience. You could be an MBA, CA, CS with aptitude for mentoring.

title: WSO2 Integration Lead
description:
**Role Description** 
 The WSO2 Integration Lead is a full\-time, on\-site role based in Kolkata. This role is responsible for designing, implementing, and maintaining WSO2\-based integration solutions across enterprise systems and applications. Daily activities include leading integration architecture discussions, developing and configuring WSO2 services and APIs, troubleshooting integration issues, and ensuring performance, scalability, and security standards are met. The Integration Lead collaborates with cross\-functional teams to gather requirements, translate them into technical specifications, and oversee end\-to\-end integration delivery.
 



  





**Experience:\- 8\-12 Years** 




  





**Core Skillsets** 
 \- WSO2 Micro Integrator / Enterprise Integrator, WSO2 API Manager, REST/SOAP, Microservices. 
 



  





**Key Responsibilities /Preferred Skills** 
 \- Lead integration architecture, WSO2 implementation, API strategy, integration patterns, SAP/Salesforce integrations, security, performance and governance.
 



  




* Candidates should possess strong Integration skills, including experience with WSO2 platforms, APIs, microservices, and enterprise system integration.
* Candidates should possess solid Software Development skills, such as proficiency in Java or similar languages, familiarity with REST/SOAP services, and understanding of CI/CD practices.
* Candidates should possess robust Analytical Skills to interpret business requirements, design scalable integration solutions, and perform root\-cause analysis.
* Candidates should possess effective Troubleshooting skills to diagnose, resolve, and prevent integration and performance issues in production environments.
* Candidates should possess clear Communication skills to collaborate with stakeholders, document technical solutions, and lead discussions with technical and non\-technical team members.
* Experience with WSO2 ESB/API Manager/Identity Server, cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, or GCP), and security standards (OAuth2, JWT, SSL/TLS) is highly beneficial.

* Exposure to enterprise data platform modernization and migration programs.

title: Head of Technology and Operational Efficiency
description:
**About the role** 




 iLEAD runs 19 undergraduate and postgraduate programmes across business, media, animation, IT and allied health sciences. As the institution has grown, so has the number of software systems, tools and manual processes in daily use across departments. Several of these are underused, poorly integrated, or worked around rather than worked with. This role exists to change that. The person we are looking for will take ownership of how technology is chosen, implemented and actually used across iLEAD, and will work with each department to find where better use of technology and clearer measurement can improve output and reduce cost. This is not a software\-building role. It is a role about making the systems we have, and the ones we adopt next, deliver real value in the hands of the people who use them.
 



 It is important to be clear about the balance of this work. The technical side matters, but it is the smaller part. The larger and harder part is getting people across a busy institution to adopt new systems and new ways of working, and to keep using them after the novelty fades. As a rough guide, expect around two thirds of the role to be people, change and coordination across departments, and about one third to be technical. The right person is comfortable with both, and is drawn to the harder two thirds rather than hiding in the easier one third.
 



**What you will own** 




**ERP rollout, adoption and maintenance** 



* Take end\-to\-end ownership of the institution\&\#39;s ERP: implementation, integration, maintenance, rollout, and day\-to\-day usage across departments.
* Resolve outstanding integration gaps so that data flows cleanly between systems instead of being re\-entered by hand, working with the relevant departments to agree the workflows that make this possible.
* Bring the institution's core administrative processes onto the system in a way that is accurate, trackable and reliable, so that leadership has a dependable picture of operations and finances.
* Make sure departments use the ERP as intended, not partially or reluctantly, and hold the standard once it is set.



**Communication and collaboration platforms** 



* Introduce, roll out and embed communication and collaboration platforms across the organisation.
* Design the adoption plan, run the training, and follow up until the new way of working has replaced the old one in practice, not just on paper.



**KPI and KRA implementation** 



* Build and own a KPI and KRA framework, and roll it out across departments so that each function has clear, measurable outcomes.
* Work with department heads to understand what each team actually does day to day, and turn that into a shared, visible picture that closes the gap between departments and leadership.
* Provide leadership with clear reporting on how the organisation is performing at the department and institution level, so that decisions rest on evidence rather than impression.



**Efficiency and Cost** 



* Work department by department to understand how work gets done today and where technology and better process can improve output, remove duplicated effort, and reduce cost.
* Review the software, tools and subscriptions the institution pays for, identify what is unused or overlapping, and consolidate where it makes sense.
* Bring findings to leadership with clear numbers and a practical plan, including the difficult findings, presented with judgement and discretion.



**Technology Direction** 



* Advise leadership on which tools and platforms iLEAD should invest in, extend, or retire, with a clear read on cost versus value.
* Identify where AI\-enabled tools can genuinely improve efficiency in administrative and support functions, and introduce them where they earn their place. AI is one tool among several here, not the purpose of the role.
* Set basic standards for data quality, access and security across the systems in use.



**What we are looking for** 




**Essential** 



* Experience owning or driving the implementation, rollout and adoption of business systems such as ERP, and getting non\-technical teams to use them properly.
* A track record of change management: introducing new tools, systems or measurement across an organisation and making the change stick against resistance.
* Experience defining and rolling out performance measurement such as KPIs or KRAs across multiple teams.
* The standing and maturity to work with senior, long\-serving colleagues, and to be firm and diplomatic at the same time, including when the message is not one people want to hear.
* A strong understanding of how technology, data and process connect, with enough technical depth to hold vendors and internal teams to account.
* Comfort with data: able to build or direct the reporting that shows leadership where effort and money are going.
* Clear, concise written and spoken communication, and the confidence to present uncomfortable findings to leadership.



**Desirable** 



* Experience in a multi\-department, service\-oriented organisation, and exposure to the education sector.
* Hands\-on experience with AI\-enabled tools and workflows in an operational setting.
* Experience with software licensing or cost and subscription rationalisation.
* Familiarity with common ERP suites, collaboration platforms, and modern data and reporting tools.



**What success looks like in the first year** 




 These are deliberately practical targets for the first twelve months. The value of this role compounds over time as adoption deepens.
 


* **Months 1 to 3:** 
 A clear picture of the systems, tools and processes in use across iLEAD, what they cost, and where they are underused or duplicated.
* **Months 3 to 6:** 
 ERP integration gaps closed and a working adoption plan in place for the departments not yet using it as intended, with core administrative and financial processes moving onto the system.
* **Months 6 to 9:** 
 Communication platform rolled out and in regular use across the organisation, and the KPI and KRA framework agreed and beginning to roll out.
* **Months 9 to 12:** 
 A first set of efficiency and cost findings delivered to leadership, with agreed actions, and clearer visibility between departments and leadership than the institution has today.



**Who this role suits, and who it does not** 



* This role will suit someone who takes satisfaction in making systems and people work well together, and who is willing to be the person who asks why a process exists at all. It involves sustained work across departments, some of it against resistance, and it rewards patience, follow\-through and clear judgement more than technical brilliance alone.
* It will not suit someone looking to build software products, lead a large engineering team, or work primarily in code. It will also not suit someone who is strong on analysis but light on the human and organisational side, because that human and organisational side is the larger part of the job. iLEAD is an education institution, not a software company. The work here is a better\-run, more efficient organisation.



**How to apply** 




 Please send your CV and a short note on a system, tool or measurement you introduced somewhere, and how you got people to actually use it, to
 **recruitment@ilead.net.in** 




 .
 



 .
 



 \#DigitalTransformation \#BusinessSystems \#OperationalExcellence \#ERP \#ChangeManagement \#TechnologyLeadership

title: Client Servicing Executive
description:
You like people. You like ideas. You like getting things done.
 
 We’re looking for a
 **Client Servicing / Account Executive** 
 who can sit between a client brief and a great piece of work and make sure neither gets lost in translation.
 



 Someone who can take a “Can we make this bigger?” call at 6 PM, turn it into an actual brief, get the creative team moving, keep the client in the loop and somehow still remember that the artwork is due tomorrow morning.
 



 Basically,
 **you make the agency work.** 



 WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING
 
**Be the client’s go\-to person.** 




 Build relationships, understand their business and make sure they always know what’s happening.
 



**Turn briefs into briefs.** 




 Listen, question, clarify and translate client requirements into something the creative, design, digital and production teams can actually work with.
 



**Keep the wheels turning.** 




 Coordinate timelines, follow\-ups, feedback, approvals, meetings and deliverables without letting anything fall through the cracks.
 



**Know your client’s business.** 




 Don’t just know what they want. Understand
 *why* 
 they want it. Keep an eye on their industry, competition, audience and brand.
 



**Work with creative teams, not against them.** 




 You don’t need to be a designer or copywriter, but you should know a good idea when you see one and be able to sell it internally and externally.
 



**Present work with confidence.** 




 Because “the creative team made this” is not a presentation.
 



**Own the chaos.** 




 There will be last\-minute changes, impossible deadlines, contradictory feedback and the occasional “small change” that isn't actually small. Deal with it. Calmly.
 


 WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR
 * **2–3 years of experience** 
 in advertising, creative agencies, digital agencies, marketing, brand communication, events or a related industry.
* Someone who is naturally
 **curious about brands, culture, people and ideas** 
 .
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Good organisational and project management skills.
* The ability to juggle multiple clients and projects without losing the plot.
* Someone who can confidently interact with clients and equally confidently challenge an idea when needed.
* Good presentation skills.
* A sharp eye for detail.
* Proficiency with everyday tools such as PowerPoint, Excel, Google Workspace and email. Knowing your way around digital and social media is a definite plus.
* Most importantly,
 **a sense of ownership** 
 . We like people who don't wait to be told what needs doing.


 BONUS POINTS IF YOU...
 
 Have opinions about advertising.
 



 Know why some campaigns work and others don't.
 



 Can explain a complicated brief without making it sound complicated.
 



 Have a decent meme game.
 



 Can spot a typo from across the room.
 



 Or simply have the habit of asking,
 **“Okay, but what are we actually trying to achieve?”** 



 WHAT YOU’LL GET
 
 A chance to work across interesting brands, categories and formats.
 



 Exposure to the entire communication process, from the first brief to the final delivery.
 



 A fast\-moving agency environment where ideas matter, initiative is appreciated and no two days are exactly alike.
 



 And colleagues who understand that
 **good work is serious business. Taking ourselves too seriously isn't.** 



 THE IMPORTANT BITS
 
**Role:** 
 Client Servicing / Account Executive
 



**Experience:** 
 2–3 years
 



**Location:** 
 Kolkata
 



**Work Mode:** 
 In\-office
 



**Industry:** 
 Advertising / Marketing / Communications
 



 If you think you can be the person who keeps clients happy, teams moving and ideas getting better,
 **we should talk.** 




  




* ﻿
 
 Company Description Versus Communications is a through\-the\-line communications agency that transforms brand narratives into emotional experiences that engage audiences and drive results. The agency operates across versusCommunications, versusEVENTS, versusFILMS, and versusSOCIAL, offering end\-to\-end brand solutions. Headquartered in Kolkata with offices in Delhi and Mumbai and representation in Bengaluru, Versus partners with leading organizations such as Tata Steel, ITC, Tata Motors, UNICEF, Apollo Hospitals, and others. The team believes that strong brands are not only seen and heard but deeply felt, creating meaningful connections between organizations and their audiences.

title: Project Manager (Interior)
description:
**Position Summary** 




 The Manager – Project Management \& Client Servicing will be responsible for managing end\-to\-end retail branding and fit\-out projects across India while serving as the primary point of contact for assigned clients. The role requires driving project execution from planning to closure, ensuring adherence to quality, timelines, budgets, and client expectations. The incumbent will collaborate with internal stakeholders, branch teams, vendors, quality teams, and clients to ensure seamless project delivery and operational excellence.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Client Relationship Management** 



* Act as the Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for assigned clients.
* Understand client requirements and translate them into executable project plans.
* Attend client meetings and prepare Minutes of Meeting (MoM).
* Build and maintain strong client relationships through proactive communication.
* Ensure adherence to agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Resolve client escalations within defined timelines.
* Present weekly, monthly, and quarterly project updates to clients.



**2\. Project Planning \& Execution** 



* Manage end\-to\-end execution of retail branding and fit\-out projects across multiple locations.
* Prepare project execution plans, deployment schedules, and milestone trackers.
* Coordinate with branch teams, procurement, fabrication, vendors, QC teams, logistics, and clients.
* Monitor complete project lifecycle from:
* Recce
* BOQ Preparation
* Client Approval
* Fabrication
* Installation
* Quality Inspection
* Work Completion Certificate (WCC)
* Project Closure
* Ensure projects are delivered within approved timelines, budget, and quality standards.
* Lead pilot projects as well as Pan India rollouts.



**3\. Smart BOQ \& Commercial Validation** 



* Review and validate BOQs prepared by field teams.
* Verify quantities against approved recce reports and site measurements.
* Ensure compliance with approved rate cards and client specifications.
* Identify quantity discrepancies, scope deviations, and commercial risks.
* Validate variation orders and assess commercial implications before approval.



**4\. Recce \& Site Survey Management** 



* Plan and monitor Pan India site survey activities.
* Review site measurements, photographs, and technical observations.
* Validate feasibility of branding and fit\-out execution.
* Coordinate BOQ revisions with branch and execution teams.
* Ensure accurate and complete site documentation.



**5\. Quality Assurance \& Compliance** 



* Conduct quality audits for fabrication and installation activities.
* Ensure compliance with approved drawings, BOQs, material specifications, and brand guidelines.
* Verify workmanship and execution quality.
* Approve project completion prior to issuance of Work Completion Certificates (WCC).
* Drive continuous improvement in quality standards.



**6\. Vendor \& Contractor Management** 



* Evaluate vendor capability, productivity, and service quality.
* Monitor vendor performance against defined KPIs and SLAs.
* Resolve execution\-related challenges through effective coordination.
* Support vendor development and performance improvement initiatives.



**7\. Team Leadership** 



* Lead and mentor QC Field Managers and project execution teams.
* Allocate daily, weekly, and project\-specific assignments.
* Conduct performance reviews, coaching sessions, and capability development initiatives.
* Support recruitment, onboarding, and training of new team members.
* Build a high\-performance, customer\-focused project team.



**8\. Operations Coordination** 



* Plan manpower deployment across multiple projects.
* Optimize resource utilization and execution schedules.
* Conduct weekly operations review meetings with cross\-functional teams.
* Monitor project progress and identify execution bottlenecks.
* Drive operational efficiency and timely project delivery.



**9\. Documentation \& Project Control** 




 Review and maintain project documentation including:
 


* Bill of Quantities (BOQs)
* Work Completion Certificates (WCCs)
* Daily Progress Reports (DPRs)
* Site Survey Reports
* Completion Reports
* QC Inspection Reports
* Photographic Documentation
* Client Approvals



 Ensure documentation accuracy, audit readiness, and compliance with organizational standards.
 



**10\. Process Improvement** 



* Develop and implement project management SOPs.
* Standardize BOQ validation and QC processes.
* Identify workflow improvement opportunities.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve operational efficiency.
* Promote best practices across projects and branches.



**11\. Commercial \& Cost Control** 



* Review project budgets and cost estimates.
* Validate commercial implications of project variations.
* Monitor project costs against approved budgets.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities without compromising quality.
* Support commercial decision\-making through data\-driven analysis.



**12\. Reporting \& MIS** 




 Prepare and review periodic reports including:
 


* Daily Project Status Reports
* Weekly Operations Dashboard
* Monthly Client Review Presentations
* QC Compliance Reports
* Project Aging Reports
* Cost Optimization Reports
* Branch Performance Dashboards
* Management MIS Reports



**13\. Training \& Knowledge Management** 



* Conduct Smart BOQ training programs.
* Train vendors on execution standards and SOPs.
* Train QC Field Managers on project execution processes.
* Develop training manuals, process documentation, and knowledge repositories.
* Share best practices and lessons learned across regional teams.

* Vendor Management

* Process Improvement

**Behavioural Competencies** 



* Leadership \& Team Management
* Decision Making
* Analytical Thinking
* Problem Solving
* Communication \& Presentation Skills
* Negotiation \& Stakeholder Management
* Planning \& Organizing
* Customer Orientation
* Ownership \& Accountability



  





**Qualification** 



* Bachelor's Degree/Diploma in Architecture/Interior Design.
* Knowledge and hands on experience on AutoCad Software
* Proficiency in MS\-Office.



**Experience** 



* 8–10 years of experience in Project Management, Retail Branding, Interior Fit\-outs, Civil Execution, or Store Rollout Projects.

description:

 Join Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited and support US\-based clients as they modernize and strengthen their tax functions through SAP\-enabled transformation. **Work you'll do**
 As a Manager, Tax Services on the Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) team, you will be responsible for:

* Engagement Management: Lead engagement planning and budgeting; mobilize and manage engagement teams; define deliverable structure and content; facilitate buy\-in of proposed solutions from top management levels at the client; direct on\-time, quality delivery of work products; manage engagement economics; and manage engagement risk.

**The team**
 Deloitte’s Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) group helps our clients’ tax departments improve their operations by developing new technology\-enabled, cutting\-edge methods and processes. Deloitte TTC professionals are aligned across our global network of member firms to address our clients’ objectives in a seamless fashion. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who help connect our clients’ global strategies and the options that exist to turn theory into an executable plan.

Companies that have already implemented or are considering implementing an enterprise resource planning (ERP) system often overlook the tax benefits these systems can provide or underestimate the impact on the tax department. To be most effective from a tax perspective, a successful ERP implementation requires professionals who specialize in tax and can effectively address a corporate tax function’s unique needs, requirements, and obligations. Our ETI team, the largest of its type, offers the necessary combination of skills, methodology and practical experience to help clients avoid the pitfalls of an ERP implementation.
   

  

 Tax Transformation Consulting (TTC) \- Ever expanding regulations and increasing scrutiny on multinational corporations has made it necessary for leading\-edge tax departments to serve a critical role in the risk management and overall performance of the enterprise. This has resulted in an opportunity for Deloitte to provide even greater value through our tax services, in helping develop tax departments of the future that are strategic, agile, and, above all, focused on creating value for the business.
   

  

 Deloitte's TTC group helps our clients’ tax department move forward from their current state to the next generation of tax functions and is dedicated to finding new methods and processes to assist clients in improving their tax operations. Deloitte Tax LLP professionals are aligned worldwide to serve our clients’ needs through the TTC group. Deloitte TTC teams include industry, tax, organizational change, technology, and co\-sourcing specialists who can help make the necessary connections between our clients’ global strategies and the many options for carrying them out in the tax function.
   

  

**Location: Bengaluru, Chennai, Gurugram, Hyderabad, Kolkata, Mumbai, Pune**

 Required:
   

  

* 8 to 15\+ years of total experience.
* 5\+ years of Implementation experience in SAP ECC 6\.0 \& S4 HANA with focus on Tax integration with SAP FICO/MM/SD integration with direct or indirect tax experience.
* Experience with design and implement SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC) solutions that support global e\-invoicing, statutory reporting, and digital compliance requirements. Experience of working across tax, finance, IT, and business stakeholders to deliver scalable SAP\-based compliance capabilities across complex ERP environments. title: Electrical and Instrumentation Engineer
description:
**Job Description** 




**Senior Manager Electrical and Instrumentation Engineer.** 




**Location:** 
 Kolkata, West Bengal \| Head Office \| On\-site with plant travel.
 



**Experience:** 
 Minimum 12 years \| Industry: Steel manufacturing only.
 



**Education:** 
 Electrical Engineering qualification required.
 



  





**About SRMB Steel** 




 SRMB Steel draws on the SRMB Group's manufacturing legacy dating to 1951\. SRMB Srijan Private Limited is an integrated primary steel producer with its head office in Kolkata and annual turnover exceeding ₹2,500 crore. Its products include TMT reinforcement bars and structural steel, with brands such as SRMB TMT, Real\-Edge, Real\-Edge Galva and Real\-Fabrica. Captive steel semis, modern production technology and quality testing facilities support the company's manufacturing operations.
 



  





**The opportunity** 




 SRMB Steel is looking for a Senior Manager Electrical to lead electrical projects, switchyard systems, automation and reliability across steel manufacturing operations. The role will provide technical oversight from engineering and construction through testing, commissioning and handover, while supporting safe and reliable operation of the company’s steelmaking and rolling assets. Only candidates with hands\-on exposure to TMT, Rolling Mill and SMS (Steel Melting Shop) operations will be considered.
 



  





**Key responsibilities** 




 Electrical projects and engineering
 



 Plan and deliver electrical projects from concept and engineering through construction, commissioning and handover. Review scope, single\-line diagrams, specifications, equipment selections, BOQs, estimates and execution schedules. Coordinate with civil, mechanical, production, safety, procurement and project teams to manage interfaces, contractors, quality, cost and milestones.
 



  





**132 kV and 33 kV switchyard systems** 




 Oversee operation, maintenance, expansion and commissioning of 132 kV and 33 kV switchyards and associated high\-tension systems. Review transformers, circuit breakers, protection relays, metering, cabling and earthing. Plan outages, inspections, testing and restoration to maintain safe, reliable power supply to plant operations.
 



  





**PLC DCS and SCADA systems** 




 Lead electrical automation and control\-system reliability across PLC, DCS and SCADA platforms. Review control logic, drive interfaces, alarms, interlocks and operating sequences. Coordinate troubleshooting, modifications, backups and system upgrades with internal teams, OEMs and specialist contractors.
 



  





**Key responsibilities continued** 




**HT switchgear MCC and VFD systems** 




 Direct inspection, preventive maintenance, testing and fault diagnosis for HT switchgear, motor control centers, VFDs, motors, transformers and critical electrical equipment. Maintain maintenance schedules, breakdown records and critical spares. Lead root\-cause reviews and implement actions that improve equipment availability and reduce repeat failures.
 



  





**Steel plant process equipment** 




 Provide electrical engineering support to induction furnaces, TMT mills, strip mills and power plant operations. Work with production and maintenance teams to resolve electrical and automation issues affecting furnace operation, rolling line performance, product flow and power availability. Support equipment upgrades and commissioning in operating plants.
 



  





**Construction and commissioning** 




 Monitor site execution for electrical installations, cable routing, panels, switchgear and control systems. Ensure inspection and test plans are followed, drawings and records are updated, punch\-list items are closed, and systems are handed over with operating and maintenance documentation.
 



  





**Reliability and maintenance planning** 




 Develop preventive and condition\-based maintenance plans for electrical and automation assets. Analyze breakdowns, downtime and recurring defects. Coordinate planned shutdown work with production and maintenance leaders, and track completion, equipment readiness and return to service.
 



  





**Electrical safety and technical standards** 




 Enforce safe systems of work for high\-voltage operations, including isolation, permits, switching procedures and contractor controls. Maintain equipment inspection and testing records. Ensure designs, installations and maintenance practices meet applicable electrical codes, company standards and statutory requirements.
 



  





**Budgets energy and team leadership** 




 Prepare project and maintenance budgets, assess technical proposals and monitor expenditure. Identify opportunities to improve energy efficiency and power quality. Lead engineers, supervisors and contractors, build technical capability, and provide clear progress, risk and performance updates to senior management.
 



  





**Candidate profile** 



* Minimum 12 years of relevant electrical engineering experience. Direct, hands\-on exposure to TMT, Rolling Mill and SMS (Steel Melting Shop) operations is mandatory; candidates without experience in all three areas will not be considered.
* Diploma or degree in Electrical Engineering. A degree in Electrical Engineering is preferred for this senior role.
* Demonstrated project experience covering electrical engineering, construction, testing, commissioning and handover in a steel plant.
* Working knowledge of 132 kV and 33 kV switchyards, HT switchgear, protection systems, MCCs, VFDs and plant power distribution.
* Hands\-on exposure to PLC, DCS and SCADA systems, including troubleshooting and coordination of plant automation changes.
* Electrical experience supporting induction furnaces, TMT mills, strip mills and power plant operations in the steel industry.
* Ability to lead contractors and technical teams, manage shutdown and project interfaces, diagnose recurring faults and communicate risks clearly.
* Ability to work from the Kolkata head office and travel to manufacturing sites.



  





**Measures of success** 



* Reliable availability of switchyards, electrical distribution and critical steel plant equipment.
* Safe, on\-schedule delivery and commissioning of approved electrical projects.
* Lower electrical breakdown frequency, downtime and repeat equipment failures.
* Improved preventive maintenance completion, testing discipline and closure of technical actions.
* Effective control of electrical project and maintenance expenditure, with identified energy improvements.

**What We Look For**

* Experience supporting CPQ\-enabled transformation programs, quote\-to\-cash process improvement, pricing and discounting workflow redesign, or commercial operations improvement projects.

description:

title: Head of Operations
description:

 ABOUT TREASURE OF VEDA
 



  





 Treasure of Veda is a fast\-growing D2C brand offering certified, energised gemstones, rudraksh, crystal bracelets, malas and personalised spiritual consultations, with customers across India and worldwide.  We are hiring a Head of Operations to be the number two to our founders. Sales and marketing stay with the founders and their teams. Everything that happens after a customer says yes is yours: the right certified product sourced, checked, packed and delivered on time, and every consultation and customer interaction delivered well.

 Fulfilment and logistics: order\-to\-delivery end to end, courier partners, dispatch SLAs, packaging, RTO and returns

 Customer experience: support, escalations, post\-sale service and reviews
 



 Team and processes: lead the ops, dispatch and support staff; write SOPs; set and track KPIs
 



 Reporting: a weekly operations dashboard to the founders covering fulfilment TAT, RTO rate, stock health, cost per order and CX metrics
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 5\+ years in operations at a D2C or e\-commerce brand, including at least 2 years leading a team
 



 Hands\-on ownership of inventory and fulfilment for physical products, ideally jewellery, gemstones, wellness or other high\-value items
 



 You have built SOPs and dashboards from scratch, not just followed them
 



 Comfortable with data: inventory sheets, courier MIS, CRM and order reports
 



 Able to manage vendors, courier partners and an internal team at the same time, and escalate clearly to the founders
 



 Based in or willing to relocate to Kolkata
 



  





 GOOD TO HAVE
 



  





 An existing vendor network for rudraksh and gemstones
 



 Experience with gem labs and certification bodies
 



 Experience in a consultation\-led or service\-plus\-product business
 



 Prior experience in a scaling D2C startup
 



  





 WHAT WE OFFER
 



  





 Rs 8 \- 12 LPA fixed, based on experience
 



 A real number\-two role: direct line to the founders and decision authority over the back end
 



 A brand built on authenticity and premium positioning, not mass production
 



 On\-site in Ballygunge, South Kolkata
 



  





 HIRING PROCESS
 



  





 Application review, then a phone screen with HR, then an in\-person interview with the founders.

title: AVP, CoreTech Governance & Risk
description:
**Role Title: AVP, CoreTech Governance and Risk (L10\)**
**Company Overview**
 Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. Synchrony delivers credit and banking products that empower tens of millions of consumers to improve their financial lives and access what matters most. Leveraging innovative solutions that are shaping the future of retail commerce, Synchrony supports the growth and success of some of the nation’s most respected brands, alongside hundreds of thousands of small and midsize businesses, including health and wellness providers. Committed to excellence in service and culture, Synchrony is proud to be named as \#3 as a Great Place to Work® in India and is honored to be ranked the \#1 Best Company to Work For® in the U.S. by Fortune magazine and Great Place to Work®. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
   

  

**Organizational Overview**
 The AVP, CoreTech Governance Lead is part of the CoreTech Governance and Risk organization and operates as a First Line of Defense (1LOD) function. This role is responsible for driving enterprise\-wide adherence to CRI, NIST, internal technology standards, and applicable regulatory requirements. The team partners closely with Technology, Audit, Compliance, Risk, and business stakeholders to identify, assess, monitor, and mitigate risks across Synchrony’s global technology infrastructure, while promoting strong governance, accountability, and risk management practices.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 AVP, CoreTech Governance \& Risk, will lead governance, risk, and compliance activities related to regulatory requirements. This role is accountable for timely issue remediation, supporting audits and regulatory examinations, managing policy lifecycles, driving risk acceptance processes, and overseeing exceptions management. The AVP collaborates cross\-functionally to ensure Synchrony mitigates risks, and provides clear, auditable documentation for internal and external stakeholders.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Issue Management: Ensure timely identification, tracking, remediation, and closure of CoreTech related issues by collaborating with Technology teams, Issue Management, Second Line of Defense (2LOD), and Internal Audit.
* Audit and Examination Support: Coordinate internal meetings, evidence collection, preparation, and responses to auditors, regulators, and Internal Audit teams.
* Risk Acceptance Oversight: Lead risk acceptance activities by managing documentation, obtaining approvals, and ensuring alignment with company policies.
* Policy Lifecycle Management: Manage the development, review, approval, and publication of CoreTech related policies, standards, and procedures.
* Exception Management: Oversee the intake, validation, documentation, and approval of exception requests, ensuring compliance with governance requirements.
* Metrics and Reporting: Provide regular status updates and metrics on issue remediation, risk acceptance activities, exceptions, and audit readiness to senior leadership and stakeholders.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
* Strong knowledge of IT controls.
* Experience managing governance and risk programs in a regulated environment.
* Proven project management and coordination skills.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams including technology, audit, and risk.
* Detail\-oriented with strong organizational and analytical abilities.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
* Prior experience supporting internal and external audits.
* Understanding of risk acceptance frameworks and process automation tools.
* Familiarity with enterprise policy management systems.
* Experience working in financial services or consumer finance industries.


**Eligibility Criteria**
 Bachelor's degree with 6\+ years of 1st Line of Defense experience Or in lieu of a degree 8\+ years of experience required.
   

  

**Work Timings**
 This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility and Choice offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs. Please discuss this with the hiring manager for more details.
   

  

**For Internal Applicants**
* Understand the mandatory skills required for the role before applying.
* Inform your manager and HRM before applying through Workday.
* Ensure your professional profile (education, prior experience, and skills) is up\-to\-date and upload your latest resume (Word or PDF).
* Must not be under any corrective action plan (First Formal/Final Formal, LPP).
* Eligibility: L9 employees must have completed 12 months in the organization and current role/level.
* L9\+ employees must have completed 18 months in the organization and 12 months in current role/level.

* Also, a must is to have 3\-5\+ years of experience in people management
* Experience in managing offshore teams, handling delivery responsibilities, coordinating directly with business managers, handling escalations etc
* Also, experience in working in a matrix organization and managing medium to large scale offshore development Centre / projects



**Why you will love working for us!**

 Linde Plc. is a leading global industrial gases and engineering company with 2024 sales of $33 billion and 65,000 employees spread across multiple countries. We live our mission of making our world more productive every day by providing high\-quality solutions, technologies and services which are making our customers more successful and helping to sustain and protect our planet.

It is a Global IT Delivery Center that has been successfully delivering IT Enabled Services to the group companies of Linde, across the world for almost two decades, since 2006\. Our goal is to provide and support IT services and solutions that are critical for the operation of the entire group. As part of Linde's core Global IT Team, we cover a wide portfolio of IT services and solutions that ensure the continuous operation of Linde's business across multiple businesses across various geographies, time zones and cultures. The technical teams use their IT skills and experience to maintain and manage the IT applications and infrastructure of the organization.
   

  

 At Linde Global IT Delivery Center, Kolkata we offer exciting career opportunities to grow and work in leading technologies in a truly global work environment.
   

  

 Whatever you seek to accomplish, and wherever you want those accomplishments to take you, a career at Linde provides limitless ways to achieve your potential, while making a positive impact in the world. Be Linde. Be Limitless.
   

  

 Have we inspired you? Let's talk about it!

The role demands deep expertise in TPRM frameworks, supply chain security, and risk lifecycle management, combined with active use of AI\-enabled tools for vendor scoring, risk prediction, and control monitoring. title: Manager Purchase
description:
**Key Responsibilities**
* Category Management \& Strategic Sourcing
* Lead end\-to\-end category management and strategic procurement for capital equipment (Greenfield \& Rebuild projects), MRO, and spare parts categories.
* Own the complete equipment build cycle: source individual parts, sub\-assemblies, and heavy components from a global and domestic supplier base, coordinate inbound logistics, and support in\-house assembly and trial runs.
* Prepare component\-level budgets for new products, conduct comprehensive market and industry research to inform category strategies, and collaborate with business area stakeholders for project estimation and cost modelling.

* Drive internal restructuring initiatives to optimize procurement performance, fostering clear accountability across specialized purchase, sourcing, and supply chain verticals.
